workflows.title: Evaluate an LLM Workflow
workflows.description: Measure an LLM feature with representative cases, explicit rubrics, failure analysis, and repeatable comparisons.
workflows.procedure: Define user tasks, failure severity, and acceptance thresholds before changing prompts or models. Build a representative, privacy-safe eval set; include edge cases and adversarial inputs. Use deterministic checks where possible and blinded human review for subjective quality. Track model/version, prompt, tools, latency, and cost. Do not present small or synthetic evals as proof of safety or broad reliability.

workflows.title: LLM Application Engineering
workflows.description: Implement reliable LLM features with structured outputs, bounded tools, privacy, and graceful failure handling.
workflows.procedure: Inspect provider APIs and existing architecture. Validate structured outputs, bound tool permissions and iteration, handle timeouts/rate limits, and provide a useful fallback. Minimize sensitive prompt data and avoid logging secrets. Ground claims in retrieved evidence when using RAG, cite provenance, and distinguish model output from verified facts. Never execute generated code or external actions without an explicit authorization path.

workflows.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
workflows.description: Build a grounded retrieval workflow with traceable sources, chunking tests, and abstention on missing evidence.
workflows.procedure: Inspect corpus rights, freshness, access controls, and query patterns. Preserve source IDs and metadata through chunking and retrieval; enforce permissions before generation. Evaluate retrieval recall and answer grounding separately using representative questions. Cite retrieved sources and abstain when evidence is insufficient. Avoid indexing secrets or restricted content; make reindexing bounded and reversible.

workflows.title: Prompt Engineering
workflows.description: Improve prompts against explicit tasks and evaluations while preserving tool and safety boundaries.
workflows.procedure: Define desired behavior, failure modes, and a small representative evaluation set before editing. Make instructions concise, scoped, and testable; resolve conflicting priorities explicitly. Avoid brittle examples and hidden assumptions. Compare revisions on the same cases and include adversarial inputs. Never claim a prompt alone guarantees factuality, privacy, or safety.

title: GNCore AI and Machine Learning
description: Frame, train, evaluate, improve, and monitor machine-learning or LLM systems with leakage-safe evidence.

workflows.title: ML Problem Framing
workflows.description: Decide whether a machine learning approach fits the task, data, constraints, and failure costs.
workflows.procedure: Define prediction or generation target, users, action, baseline, data rights, latency/cost limits, error costs, and non-ML alternatives. Set measurable acceptance and stop criteria before choosing a model.

workflows.title: ML Dataset Audit
workflows.description: Audit dataset provenance, schema, representativeness, label quality, leakage, and split strategy.
workflows.procedure: Profile source, labels, duplicates, missingness, time coverage, sensitive fields, and collection process. Group splits by user/entity/time where needed; preserve raw data and document exclusion rules.

workflows.title: ML Preprocessing Pipeline
workflows.description: Build deterministic preprocessing that prevents leakage and preserves training-to-serving parity.
workflows.procedure: Fit learned transforms only on training data, persist the pipeline, validate schema and edge cases, and compare transformed distributions across splits. Track every row or column excluded and why.

workflows.title: ML Model Training Run
workflows.description: Implement a reproducible model training run with configuration, baseline, checkpoints, and evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Inspect framework and hardware, establish baseline, lock data split and metric, set seed and run metadata, and checkpoint safely. Do not launch expensive compute or overwrite artifacts without explicit user authorization.

workflows.title: ML Model Evaluation
workflows.description: Evaluate model quality, uncertainty, subgroup behavior, and representative errors against a baseline.
workflows.procedure: Use a held-out split untouched by tuning, task-appropriate metrics, confidence estimates where practical, and error slices. State sample limits and do not infer safety or production readiness from aggregate scores.

workflows.title: ML Improvement Loop
workflows.description: Improve a model through controlled experiments with a fixed evaluation protocol and root-cause analysis.
workflows.procedure: Rank hypotheses from observed errors, change one factor at a time, track config and artifacts, compare against baseline, diagnose regressions, fix or revert, then rerun focused and regression evaluations until gates pass or a blocker remains.

workflows.title: LLM Evaluation Suite
workflows.description: Evaluate an LLM feature with representative tasks, rubrics, adversarial cases, latency, and cost.
workflows.procedure: Create a privacy-safe eval set, use deterministic checks where possible, score subjective quality with a rubric, and record model/prompt/tool versions. Separate benchmark performance from real-world safety claims.

workflows.title: RAG Grounding Workflow
workflows.description: Build and evaluate retrieval-augmented answers with source access controls and abstention.
workflows.procedure: Preserve source identity and permissions through ingestion and retrieval; measure retrieval separately from answer quality; cite evidence; test missing, conflicting, stale, and unauthorized sources; abstain when support is insufficient.

workflows.title: Model Fine-Tuning Plan
workflows.description: Assess fine-tuning suitability and prepare a controlled, leakage-safe fine-tuning workflow.
workflows.procedure: Compare prompt, retrieval, and fine-tuning alternatives; verify dataset rights and de-identification; deduplicate and split before training; define eval and rollback. Require approval before paid training or external data upload.

workflows.title: Model Release and Monitoring

workflows.procedure: Link code, data, config, artifact, eval, serving contract, and owner. Gate release on tested rollback and monitoring for quality, latency, cost, and drift; do not deploy without explicit authorization.

workflows.title: Product Analytics
workflows.description: Define product metrics and event instrumentation that answer a decision without collecting unnecessary data.
workflows.procedure: Start with the decision and user outcome, then define event grain, actor, timestamp, properties, denominator, and exclusions. Check identity stitching, consent, retention, and duplicate events. Prefer a small event schema with stable names and versioning. Validate counts end to end and document known blind spots. Avoid collecting sensitive attributes without a clear, approved need.

workflows.title: Workflow Automation

workflows.procedure: Map triggers, inputs, side effects, failure modes, and owners before automating. Select only the matching stack and the specialist skills needed for the request. Implement the scoped service behavior and verify its success, failure, and permission paths. Use existing infrastructure and interfaces unless the user requests a change.

workflows.title: GNCore Backend Code Quality
workflows.description: Improve backend correctness and maintainability across boundaries, data handling, concurrency, and error paths.
workflows.procedure: Inspect a representative request or job path before refactoring. Check validation at boundaries, authorization at sensitive operations, ownership of transactions and state, cancellation and timeout behavior, and error propagation. Prefer clear interfaces and explicit invariants over generic abstraction layers. Make a focused improvement and verify relevant observable behavior; use the code quality, review, contract, or stack workflow that addresses the actual problem.

workflows.title: GNCore Backend Security
workflows.description: Review and repair backend authentication, object authorization, input handling, session, and secret boundaries.
workflows.procedure: Trace untrusted input and identity through each sensitive operation. Check object-level authorization, injection-safe queries, output handling, session and CSRF controls where relevant, and redacted failures. Reproduce concrete issues locally and verify allowed and denied cases after fixing them. Distinguish a scoped review from a claim that the whole service is secure.

workflows.title: GNCore Backend Observability
workflows.description: Design and verify useful service logs, traces, metrics, and alert signals with bounded overhead.
workflows.procedure: Identify service entrypoints, external calls, background jobs, and meaningful failure boundaries. Reuse existing telemetry conventions, propagate correlation context, redact sensitive values, and bound label cardinality. Verify a representative success and failure path emits useful signals. Use Sentry-specific workflows only for Sentry projects; separate local verification from evidence from a connected production system.

title: GNCore Business Communications
description: Draft and edit executive briefs, emails, updates, policies, reports, crisis messages, and localized business content.

workflows.title: Executive Brief

workflows.procedure: Lead with the decision, show verified evidence and assumptions, compare options/risks, name owner and deadline, and keep detail traceable.

workflows.title: Business Email
workflows.description: Draft audience-appropriate business email with a clear next action.
workflows.procedure: State purpose early, include relevant context, clarify request and deadline, preserve facts, and remove unnecessary sensitive information.

workflows.title: Stakeholder Update
workflows.description: Report status, changes, blockers, decisions, and next steps.
workflows.procedure: Use dated facts, distinguish done/in progress/at risk, name owners/dates, identify decisions, and avoid unsupported confidence.

workflows.title: Internal Policy Draft
workflows.description: Draft policy with scope, rules, owner, exceptions, and review cadence.
workflows.procedure: Identify authority and audience, define terms, make requirements testable, include escalation and version owner, and route legal/HR review.

workflows.title: Business Report
workflows.description: Connect evidence to conclusions and actions in a structured report.
workflows.procedure: Define question and scope, cite data, label methods and limits, separate observation from interpretation, assign recommendation owners.

workflows.title: Crisis Communications
workflows.description: Prepare a factual holding statement and update plan for an incident.
workflows.procedure: Use verified facts, state known/unknown, avoid speculation, identify authorized spokesperson and approval path, set next update time.

workflows.title: Clarity and Tone Edit
workflows.description: Edit writing for clarity, audience fit, accuracy, and consistent tone.
workflows.procedure: Preserve meaning, verify names/numbers against sources, remove ambiguity, retain requested voice, and list material edits.

workflows.title: Meeting Brief and Minutes
workflows.description: Prepare agendas and decision-focused minutes with owners and follow-ups.
workflows.procedure: Set outcomes/time boxes, separate decisions from discussion, capture action owners/dates, distinguish facts from open issues, share selectively.

workflows.title: Business Content Localization
workflows.description: Adapt content to a locale while preserving meaning, policy, and usability.
workflows.procedure: Confirm locale/audience, preserve legal and product terms, adapt formats, flag uncertain claims, and require local expert review for high impact.

workflows.title: Communications Quality Check
workflows.description: Quality-check business communications before distribution.
workflows.procedure: Check audience, purpose, facts, names, dates, links, attachments, accessibility, confidentiality, approvals, and action; verify final artifact.

title: GNCore Business Operations
description: Improve operating processes, procedures, capacity, controls, quality, continuity, and automation.

workflows.title: Process Mapping
workflows.description: Map a business process from trigger to outcome and expose waste and control gaps.
workflows.procedure: Identify actors, inputs, decisions, handoffs, systems, exceptions, wait time, and controls using observed evidence. Validate the map with process owners before redesigning it.

workflows.title: Standard Operating Procedure
workflows.description: Write an actionable SOP with prerequisites, steps, decision points, and recovery paths.
workflows.procedure: Name the owner, scope, required access, safety constraints, expected output, and review cadence. Write steps in executable order, include exception handling, and test the procedure with a user unfamiliar with the process.

workflows.title: Operations KPI Review
workflows.description: Analyze operational KPIs against service outcomes, baselines, and capacity limits.
workflows.procedure: Verify source, definition, grain, freshness, target, and denominator. Investigate variation and leading indicators, segment material differences, and avoid ranking teams without adjusting for workload and case mix.

workflows.title: Service Quality Improvement
workflows.description: Reduce recurring service defects through root-cause analysis and controlled countermeasures.
workflows.procedure: Define defect and baseline, stratify by process stage, confirm root cause with evidence, and test one countermeasure at a time. Monitor unintended effects and sustain only improvements that persist.

workflows.title: Capacity and Queue Planning
workflows.description: Forecast service capacity and queues with explicit demand, throughput, and uncertainty.
workflows.procedure: Measure arrival rates, service times, backlog, variability, and staffing constraints. Model scenarios and service targets, identify bottlenecks, and disclose assumptions rather than relying on average utilization alone.

workflows.title: Operational Control Design
workflows.description: Design practical controls that prevent or detect costly process failures.
workflows.procedure: Map risk to preventive and detective controls, accountable owner, evidence, frequency, exceptions, and remediation. Minimize duplicate checks and test whether the control catches realistic failures.

workflows.title: Business Operations Incident
workflows.description: Coordinate a non-technical operational incident and restore service with clear ownership.
workflows.procedure: Establish customer and business impact, scope, timeline, safe containment, communications owner, and recovery criterion. Preserve records and avoid unapproved external commitments or irreversible actions.

workflows.title: Vendor Operations Review
workflows.description: Review vendor delivery against service commitments, risks, dependencies, and corrective actions.
workflows.procedure: Compare service evidence to contract and agreed measures, record exceptions, assess concentration and continuity risk, and agree owners and dates for remediation. Route contract interpretation to counsel.

workflows.title: Business Continuity Plan
workflows.description: Prepare a business continuity response for essential processes and credible disruption scenarios.
workflows.procedure: Identify critical services, impact tolerances, dependencies, alternate procedures, contacts, data recovery, and exercise cadence. Verify the plan with a tabletop; distinguish assumed capability from tested capability.

workflows.title: Operations Automation Case
workflows.description: Assess whether an operational task is ready for safe automation and quantify its value.
workflows.procedure: Measure current volume, variation, exception rate, labor, error cost, and control obligations. Keep human review for ambiguous or high-impact cases, define fallback, and pilot against a measured baseline.

title: GNCore Business Strategy

workflows.title: Market Entry Strategy
workflows.description: Evaluate entry into a new market using evidence, economics, and staged commitments.
workflows.procedure: Assess market size and quality, customer needs, competitors, regulation, localization, channel access, and unit economics. Show source dates and assumptions; define a low-cost validation gate before irreversible investment.

workflows.title: Portfolio Prioritization
workflows.description: Rank business initiatives by strategic value, evidence, capacity, and opportunity cost.
workflows.procedure: Use a consistent scoring model with confidence ranges, dependencies, resource demand, and strategic fit. Challenge sunk-cost bias and show which work loses capacity under each proposed portfolio.

workflows.title: Competitive Analysis
workflows.description: Compare competitors using verifiable evidence and decision-relevant positioning.
workflows.procedure: Use dated primary evidence where available; distinguish fact, inference, and unknown. Compare target segments, offer, pricing, distribution, differentiation, and likely response without presenting speculation as competitor intent.

workflows.title: Business Model Review
workflows.description: Map a business model and test whether its value creation and capture are sustainable.
workflows.procedure: Trace customer, value proposition, channels, cost structure, revenue, key resources, and dependencies. Check contribution margin and incentives across the model; identify assumptions to validate before scaling.

workflows.title: Strategic Scenario Planning
workflows.description: Build plausible scenarios and decision triggers for uncertain business conditions.
workflows.procedure: Select a small number of material uncertainties, construct coherent scenarios, and quantify directional consequences. Define leading signals, robust actions, contingent options, and triggers; do not treat scenarios as forecasts.

workflows.title: Strategy to OKRs
workflows.description: Translate strategic intent into measurable outcomes and aligned quarterly objectives.
workflows.procedure: Write outcome-based objectives, baseline-backed key results, owners, review cadence, and dependencies. Check that metrics are controllable, non-duplicative, and resistant to gaming; distinguish targets from forecasts.

workflows.title: Pricing Strategy
workflows.description: Analyze pricing architecture, willingness-to-pay evidence, and margin consequences.
workflows.procedure: Define customer segments, packaging, price metric, discounts, costs, elasticity evidence, and competitor context. Model conversion and retention trade-offs; propose controlled tests and guardrails before broad changes.

workflows.title: Enterprise Risk Assessment
workflows.description: Prioritize strategic risks by likelihood, impact, exposure, and mitigation evidence.
workflows.procedure: Define risk events and time horizon, assess inherent and residual exposure, identify controls and owners, and document uncertainty. Use consistent scoring and distinguish risk appetite from a claim that risk is eliminated.

workflows.title: M&A Opportunity Screen
workflows.description: Screen an acquisition or partnership opportunity against strategic and financial criteria.
workflows.procedure: Assess fit, synergies, integration load, valuation assumptions, diligence gaps, regulatory exposure, and alternatives. Label preliminary analysis clearly and route legal, tax, accounting, and investment conclusions to qualified reviewers.

workflows.title: Business Transformation Plan
workflows.description: Design a staged transformation with outcomes, governance, adoption, and measurable benefits.
workflows.procedure: Set a baseline, target operating model, workstreams, decision rights, change impacts, risks, and benefit owners. Sequence pilots and releases; track realized outcomes separately from promised savings.

title: GNCore Cloud
description: Evaluate cloud architecture and cost choices against workload, reliability, security, and operational constraints.

workflows.title: Cloud Architecture
workflows.description: Design a cloud deployment around explicit reliability, security, operations, and cost constraints.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the current provider, workload, data classification, traffic, recovery targets, team skills, and budget. Prefer managed services only when their operational and cost tradeoffs fit. Define trust boundaries, failure modes, backup/restore, and observability. Do not create resources or expose endpoints without authorization. Mark estimates and assumptions; avoid claiming compliance without evidence.

workflows.title: Cloud Cost Optimization
workflows.description: Find measurable cloud cost reductions while protecting reliability and workload correctness.
workflows.procedure: Use billing and utilization evidence with a stated period and scope. Separate idle waste, rightsizing, storage lifecycle, and architecture changes. Estimate savings and service risk; identify reversibility and validation. Avoid deleting resources, reducing capacity, or purchasing commitments without approval. Measure after a change and retain rollback options.

title: GNCore Cloud, DevOps, and SRE

workflows.title: Cloud Architecture Review
workflows.description: Compare cloud designs against workload, reliability, security, cost, and operational constraints.
workflows.procedure: Clarify workload and provider, data classification, traffic, recovery targets, team skills, and budget. Trace failure domains, IAM, data movement, backup/restore, observability, and cost; mark assumptions.

workflows.title: Infrastructure as Code
workflows.description: Author or review infrastructure changes with plan inspection, least privilege, and rollback.
workflows.procedure: Use existing modules and provider versions, isolate environments, validate state and drift, inspect the generated plan, and protect secrets. Do not apply or destroy live infrastructure without explicit approval.

workflows.title: CI/CD Pipeline
workflows.description: Improve a delivery pipeline with reproducibility, least privilege, useful gates, and rollback.
workflows.procedure: Trace build provenance, secrets, permissions, test stages, artifact promotion, deployment strategy, and recovery. Verify the pipeline on a safe branch or environment and preserve protected release checks.

workflows.title: Container Build and Hardening
workflows.description: Build a reproducible container with a minimal attack surface and reliable runtime behavior.
workflows.procedure: Inspect runtime and platform needs; minimize base and copied files, run non-root, pin controlled inputs, exclude secrets, scan outputs, and test health/shutdown behavior. Do not publish images without permission.

workflows.title: Kubernetes Workload Review
workflows.description: Review Kubernetes workloads for availability, resource bounds, identity, health, and rollout safety.
workflows.procedure: Check probes, requests/limits, replicas, disruption, security context, service-account scope, network exposure, rollout and rollback. Validate rendered manifests and never apply to a live cluster without approval.

workflows.title: SLO and Error Budget
workflows.description: Define service-level indicators and objectives that reflect user-visible reliability.
workflows.procedure: Choose user-centric good/total events, window, target, exclusions, and data source. Validate measurement and alerting; use error budgets to guide decisions without hiding user impact.

workflows.title: Service Observability
workflows.description: Instrument service behavior with actionable metrics, structured logs, and traces.
workflows.procedure: Start from user failure modes, define low-cardinality signals, preserve trace context, exclude secrets and personal data, and set sampling/retention. Verify telemetry against a known request and cost.

workflows.title: SRE Incident Management
workflows.description: Manage a reliability incident through impact assessment, safe mitigation, verification, and learning.
workflows.procedure: Set incident roles and timeline, assess user impact, state mitigation hypothesis, preserve evidence, and verify recovery against SLO signals. Record root-cause contributors without blame and track corrective work.

workflows.title: Capacity and Load Plan
workflows.description: Plan service capacity using measured demand, bottleneck data, growth uncertainty, and failure headroom.
workflows.procedure: Profile representative workload, identify saturation point and dependencies, model peak and failure scenarios, and define scaling thresholds. Avoid changes based only on average utilization.

workflows.title: Cloud Cost Optimization
workflows.description: Reduce measurable infrastructure spend while protecting service objectives and recovery options.
workflows.procedure: Use dated billing and utilization evidence, classify waste versus required headroom, estimate savings and risk, and test reversible changes. Do not delete, downsize, or purchase commitments without approval.

title: GNCore Company Leadership
description: Prepare executive decisions, operating reviews, board materials, and cross-functional commitments.

workflows.title: CEO Decision Brief
workflows.description: Prepare an evidence-led CEO brief for a company-level decision.
workflows.procedure: Synthesize strategy, financial position, customer outcomes, people capacity, risks, and decision options. State the decision owner, recommendation, trade-offs, leading indicators, and what evidence could change the recommendation; do not invent company facts.

workflows.title: CFO Review
workflows.description: Review financial performance, liquidity, and capital choices for executive decisions.
workflows.procedure: Reconcile reported figures to their source and period, separate actuals from forecasts, explain cash and margin drivers, and show scenario sensitivities. Flag accounting assumptions and decisions that need a qualified controller or auditor.

workflows.title: COO Operating Review
workflows.description: Diagnose operational performance and turn bottlenecks into accountable actions.
workflows.procedure: Map the end-to-end operating flow, service levels, capacity, constraints, owners, and failure costs. Prioritize a small set of measurable interventions and verify each action does not move the bottleneck or risk downstream service.

workflows.title: CTO Technology Review
workflows.description: Assess technology direction, engineering execution, and technical risk for leadership.
workflows.procedure: Connect technical choices to customer value, reliability, security, delivery capacity, and lifecycle cost. Distinguish observed system evidence from estimates and present reversible options before recommending platform-wide change.

workflows.title: Chief Product Officer Review
workflows.description: Align product portfolio decisions with customer evidence and company outcomes.
workflows.procedure: Compare opportunities by user problem, evidence strength, strategic fit, expected impact, delivery cost, and opportunity cost. Identify what to stop or defer and define measurable product outcomes rather than output targets.

workflows.title: Chief Marketing Officer Review
workflows.description: Evaluate marketing strategy, brand health, and growth investment for executives.
workflows.procedure: Connect audience, positioning, channel economics, pipeline attribution, brand measures, and budget. Separate incremental impact from correlation, expose attribution uncertainty, and recommend a testable allocation decision.

workflows.title: Chief People Officer Review
workflows.description: Review workforce health, organization design, and talent risks with appropriate privacy.
workflows.procedure: Use aggregated workforce evidence, role capacity, retention, hiring, engagement, and employee relations context. Avoid unsupported causal claims or unnecessary personal data; identify fair, lawful, and measurable interventions.

workflows.title: Chief Information Security Officer Review
workflows.description: Brief executives on cyber risk, exposure, and risk-reduction decisions.
workflows.procedure: Describe assets, threat scenarios, business impact, control evidence, residual risk, and accountable owners in plain language. Distinguish verified incidents from hypotheses and define containment or investment gates without exposing secrets.

workflows.title: Board Materials Review
workflows.description: Prepare or review board-level materials for clarity, governance, and decision quality.
workflows.procedure: Separate items for decision, discussion, and information. Reconcile headline metrics, surface material risks and conflicts, state management's recommendation, and preserve confidential or legally privileged material appropriately.

workflows.title: Executive Team Alignment
workflows.description: Resolve cross-functional decisions into shared priorities, owners, and measurable commitments.
workflows.procedure: Identify the decision, competing incentives, dependencies, and unresolved assumptions. Record one accountable owner, contributing functions, decision deadline, success measures, and escalation trigger for each commitment.

title: GNCore Content
description: Plan, adapt, translate, and maintain content around audience needs, factual accuracy, and channel constraints.

workflows.title: Content Strategy
workflows.description: Plan clear, consistent content around a specific audience, task, evidence, and publishing goal.
workflows.procedure: Identify audience, intent, channel, evidence, and desired action. Organize content around reader questions, use plain language, and preserve source attribution. Flag claims needing verification and avoid unsupported health, legal, or financial promises. Provide an outline, publication checklist, and success measure appropriate to the channel.

workflows.title: Technical Localization
workflows.description: Adapt technical content across languages while preserving product meaning, UI limits, and verified terminology.
workflows.procedure: Identify source locale, target locale, audience, and approved glossary. Preserve code, placeholders, links, units, legal meaning, and formatting tokens. Flag ambiguous source text instead of guessing. Use locale-appropriate dates and numbers; do not translate identifiers. Verify UI length and right-to-left behavior when relevant.

title: GNCore Customer Success and Support
description: Triage customer issues and prepare responses, escalations, onboarding, health reviews, and renewals.

workflows.title: Customer Onboarding Plan
workflows.description: Guide a customer to a defined first outcome with owners, milestones, and adoption signals.
workflows.procedure: Confirm desired outcomes, prerequisites, stakeholders, technical dependencies, timeline, and customer capacity. Define evidence of activation and escalate risks early without promising unapproved delivery dates.

workflows.title: Support Case Triage
workflows.description: Classify a support issue by impact, urgency, reproducibility, and routing evidence.
workflows.procedure: Capture affected users, symptoms, start time, scope, workaround, environment, and sensitive-data considerations. Assign severity from documented policy, request minimal diagnostics, and avoid guessing root cause.

workflows.title: Customer Support Reply
workflows.description: Draft a clear customer reply that addresses the issue, next action, and known limits.
workflows.procedure: Acknowledge the reported impact, state verified findings, give one concrete next step and owner, and set a truthful update time. Do not blame the customer or invent a fix timeline.

workflows.title: Customer Escalation Brief
workflows.description: Prepare an escalation brief with impact, timeline, evidence, owner, and decision request.
workflows.procedure: Summarize customer context, verified impact, actions taken, outstanding risks, communication commitments, and requested decision. Keep internal speculation out of customer-facing text.

workflows.title: Customer Health Review
workflows.description: Assess customer health from transparent adoption, outcome, relationship, and support signals.
workflows.procedure: Define signal sources and freshness, distinguish product usage from realized value, include stakeholder coverage and open risks, and expose missing data. Treat health scores as triage aids, not objective truth.

workflows.title: Customer Renewal Risk
workflows.description: Build a renewal action plan grounded in value realization, stakeholder needs, and contract facts.
workflows.procedure: Verify renewal date and terms, map outcomes achieved versus expected, open issues, decision makers, and recovery actions. Avoid pressure tactics and do not imply contractual rights without review.

workflows.title: Support Knowledge Article
workflows.description: Write a tested support article that resolves a common issue with clear prerequisites and recovery.
workflows.procedure: Reproduce the supported scenario, state affected versions and prerequisites, order steps safely, include expected results and recovery, and link escalation criteria. Have another person follow the instructions before publishing.

workflows.title: Voice of Customer Synthesis
workflows.description: Combine customer evidence into actionable themes with source coverage and counterexamples.
workflows.procedure: Preserve source, segment, date, and context; separate direct statements from interpretation; note sample bias and conflicting evidence. Recommend owners and validation, not a false consensus.

workflows.title: Service Recovery Plan
workflows.description: Restore trust after a service failure through verified facts, ownership, and follow-through.
workflows.procedure: Confirm impact and affected commitments, coordinate approved remedy, communicate with empathy and accuracy, and track completion. Do not admit legal liability or offer compensation outside authority.

workflows.title: Customer Business Review
workflows.description: Prepare a customer review that connects usage, outcomes, open risks, and next-period goals.
workflows.procedure: Use agreed success criteria and validated data, show progress and limits, include customer voice and unresolved issues, and align a small set of next actions with owners and dates.

title: GNCore Cybersecurity
description: Assess threats, code risks, vulnerabilities, incidents, identity, cloud controls, and security validation plans.

workflows.title: Threat Model
workflows.description: Map assets, trust boundaries, threats, controls, and residual risk for a bounded system.
workflows.procedure: Use an explicit scope and attacker model, diagram data flows and entry points, rank plausible threats, tie mitigations to owners, and record residual risk. Do not probe systems outside authorized scope.

workflows.title: Secure Code Review
workflows.description: Review a code change for exploitable input, identity, authorization, secret, and data-flow flaws.
workflows.procedure: Trace attacker-controlled inputs to sensitive operations, verify server-side authorization and safe encoding, identify reproducible findings, and recommend minimal fixes with regression tests. Avoid unapproved live exploitation.

workflows.title: Vulnerability Triage
workflows.description: Prioritize a reported vulnerability using affected assets, exploitability, exposure, and impact evidence.
workflows.procedure: Verify affected versions and reachable paths, validate evidence in a safe environment, assess exposure and compensating controls, assign severity using policy, and coordinate fix/mitigation and retest.

workflows.title: Cyber Incident Response
workflows.description: Coordinate defensive incident response with containment, evidence preservation, and recovery gates.
workflows.procedure: Establish scope and confidence, preserve logs and chain of custody, select reversible containment with owner approval, coordinate communications, eradicate safely, and verify recovery. Keep hypotheses separate from confirmed facts.

workflows.title: Identity and Access Review
workflows.description: Review identities and permissions for least privilege, lifecycle, ownership, and audit evidence.
workflows.procedure: Inventory human and service identities, roles, privilege, owner, last use, and authentication controls. Validate exceptions and break-glass paths; recommend revocation only through authorized change control.

workflows.title: Cloud Security Review
workflows.description: Assess cloud configuration against an explicit threat model and approved security baseline.
workflows.procedure: Check identity boundaries, public exposure, encryption, network paths, logging, backups, and configuration drift. Cite exact resources and evidence; do not change production settings without authorization.

workflows.title: Security Control Evidence
workflows.description: Map supplied evidence to security control requirements with traceable, bounded conclusions.
workflows.procedure: Use the named control version, identify evidence period and system scope, note sample and gaps, and distinguish designed from operating effectiveness. Do not claim certification or compliance from incomplete evidence.

workflows.title: Phishing Response Triage
workflows.description: Triage a suspected phishing report and provide safe containment and user guidance.
workflows.procedure: Preserve message headers and indicators, verify links without opening them, identify affected users and credential exposure, and route containment through authorized tooling. Do not forward malicious content broadly.

workflows.title: Exposed Secret Response
workflows.description: Respond to a potentially exposed credential without echoing or spreading the secret.
workflows.procedure: Identify credential type and exposure window without printing its value, notify the owner, revoke or rotate using approved procedure, audit use, and remove exposure from accessible history where possible.

workflows.title: Authorized Security Test Plan
workflows.description: Define a bounded security test plan with written authorization, targets, limits, and stop conditions.
workflows.procedure: Record asset owner approval, exact scope, allowed techniques, dates, rate limits, data handling, contacts, and stop rules. Keep testing non-destructive and report only verified findings to authorized recipients.

title: GNCore Data
description: Inspect, transform, analyze, and move data through reproducible pipelines with explicit contracts.

workflows.title: Data Analysis
workflows.description: Answer data questions with reproducible calculations, clear definitions, and honest uncertainty.
workflows.procedure: Translate the question into a measurable quantity and inspect the relevant columns and missingness. Show the denominator, filters, time window, and aggregation. Check duplicates and outliers where they affect the answer. Label estimates and caveats; never fabricate values or imply causation from correlation.

workflows.title: Data Pipeline Engineering
workflows.description: Build reliable, observable data pipelines with explicit schemas, retries, and idempotency.
workflows.procedure: Trace source-to-sink data flow and failure semantics. Define schema and validation at boundaries, make retries idempotent, handle late or duplicate records, and emit actionable logs without secrets or sensitive payloads. Preserve existing schedules and production destinations unless the request explicitly changes them.

title: GNCore Data Analytics and Intelligence
description: Answer business questions with reproducible data audits, SQL, metrics, cohorts, experiments, forecasts, and dashboards.

workflows.title: Analytics Question Plan
workflows.description: Translate a business question into a measurable analysis plan and data requirements.
workflows.procedure: Define decision, population, unit of analysis, outcome, comparison, time range, data sources, and limitations before querying. Identify causal language that the available design cannot support.

workflows.title: Data Quality Audit
workflows.description: Audit analytical data for missingness, duplication, validity, freshness, and grain.
workflows.procedure: Profile schema, keys, nulls, ranges, category drift, late arrivals, and row grain. Report counts and affected segments, preserve raw data, and turn material defects into owned checks.

workflows.title: Business SQL Analysis
workflows.description: Write a traceable SQL analysis with correct grain, joins, time handling, and reconciliation.
workflows.procedure: Inspect source definitions, declare expected row grain, parameterize inputs, verify join cardinality, and reconcile totals to a trusted control. Avoid expensive or mutating production queries without authorization.

workflows.title: Decision Dashboard
workflows.description: Design a dashboard around a recurring decision with clear metrics, filters, and data freshness.
workflows.procedure: Name the audience and decision, define metrics and denominators, show time window and freshness, add useful breakdowns, and check accessibility. Remove charts that do not change a decision.

workflows.title: Metric Tree
workflows.description: Decompose a business outcome into leading drivers and measurable operational inputs.
workflows.procedure: Define the top outcome, decompose mathematically or causally only where evidence supports it, annotate owner and source for each metric, and distinguish controllable inputs from external factors.

workflows.title: Cohort Analysis
workflows.description: Compare cohort behavior with consistent definitions, exposure windows, and censoring treatment.
workflows.procedure: Specify cohort entry, event, observation window, time zone, exclusions, and incomplete follow-up. Check cohort comparability and report uncertainty and survivorship bias.

workflows.title: Business Experiment Analysis
workflows.description: Analyze an experiment with assignment, exposure, predeclared outcomes, and uncertainty checks.
workflows.procedure: Validate randomization, sample ratio, instrumentation, metric definition, duration, and stopping rule. Estimate effect with uncertainty and guardrails; do not declare success from post-hoc slicing.

workflows.title: Business Forecast Analysis
workflows.description: Build a business forecast from history, drivers, scenarios, and out-of-sample checks.
workflows.procedure: Check data coverage and structural changes, establish a simple baseline, use time-ordered validation, and compare scenarios. Explain forecast error and avoid false precision or unsupported causal narratives.

workflows.title: Executive Analytics Brief
workflows.description: Turn analysis into a concise decision brief with traceable evidence and caveats.
workflows.procedure: Lead with the decision and finding, show key numbers with units and denominators, link to source and method, explain alternatives and limitations, and specify next actions and owners.

workflows.title: Analytics Data Contract
workflows.description: Specify ownership, schema, quality, freshness, and change handling for an analytics dataset.
workflows.procedure: Document grain, fields, types, allowed values, null semantics, primary keys, freshness SLA, owner, consumers, and compatibility policy. Define tests and an escalation route for breaking changes.

title: GNCore Data Engineering
description: Design databases, data pipelines, and governance with explicit schemas, ownership, lineage, and quality controls.

workflows.title: Database Design
workflows.description: Design safe relational data models, queries, and migrations that preserve integrity and performance.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the database engine, schema, constraints, data volume, and access patterns. Encode invariants with appropriate constraints and indexes; parameterize input. Make migrations reversible and consider locking, backfill, and compatibility. Never run destructive SQL or apply a migration to production without explicit authorization. Verify query plans or migration behavior with a safe local fixture when possible.

workflows.title: Data Pipeline Engineering
workflows.description: Build observable, restartable pipelines with explicit schemas, idempotency, and data-quality checks.
workflows.procedure: Trace source, ownership, freshness, volume, schema evolution, and retry semantics. Make stages idempotent, checkpoint safely, validate schemas and key quality invariants, and expose useful failure context. Protect credentials and sensitive data. Keep backfills bounded and never trigger production backfills or mutate source systems without authorization.

workflows.title: Data Governance
workflows.description: Define practical ownership, quality, access, lineage, and retention controls for a data asset.
workflows.procedure: Identify asset owner, purpose, source, sensitivity, consumers, transformations, quality expectations, and retention. Propose least-privilege access, lineage, quality checks, and deletion handling. Separate policy facts from recommendations and flag legal or regulatory interpretations for experts. Avoid copying sensitive datasets into examples or test fixtures.

title: GNCore Data Science
description: Clean and analyze data with reproducible SQL, statistics, experiments, visualizations, and spatial methods.

workflows.title: Clean a Dataset
workflows.description: Audit and clean a dataset with explicit, reversible rules for missing values, duplicates, types, and outliers.
workflows.procedure: Profile the raw data before changing it: schema, nulls, duplicate keys, invalid ranges, category variants, and suspicious distributions. Clarify what each row represents and preserve a read-only source. Apply only defensible rules, log affected rows and counts, and keep a reproducible script. Do not silently impute, discard outliers, deduplicate on an arbitrary field, or overwrite the original. Compare before/after summaries and flag ambiguous cases.

workflows.title: Analyze Data
workflows.description: Answer a data question with reproducible analysis, explicit assumptions, and evidence tied to the provided data.
workflows.procedure: Clarify the unit of analysis and question. Inspect data definitions, missingness, time coverage, and possible selection bias before calculating. Use suitable summaries and comparisons; show denominators and uncertainty when relevant. Separate association from causation and observed facts from interpretation. Keep queries or code reproducible, avoid exposing sensitive records, and state what the data cannot establish.

workflows.title: SQL Analysis
workflows.description: Write correct, reviewable SQL for analytics while guarding against join fanout and misleading aggregates.
workflows.procedure: Read table definitions and grain before joining. State the intended row grain, join keys, time zone, null behavior, and filters. Check for fanout and use explicit columns. Validate row counts, distinct keys, and edge cases against a small known sample. Avoid expensive full scans or writes on production systems unless explicitly authorized; explain assumptions and query cost risks.

workflows.title: Data Visualization
workflows.description: Create clear charts that faithfully represent the underlying data and its uncertainty.
workflows.procedure: Match chart form to the question and data type. Label units, denominators, time range, and transformations; show missing data and uncertainty when material. Use honest axes and accessible color/labels. Validate plotted values against source aggregates and avoid implying causality from descriptive data. Keep dashboards focused on decisions and explain filters and refresh timing.

workflows.title: Statistical Analysis
workflows.description: Choose and interpret statistical methods with assumptions, uncertainty, and practical effects stated clearly.
workflows.procedure: Translate the question into an estimand and identify sampling and assignment mechanisms. Check assumptions, missingness, dependence, and multiple testing. Report effect size and uncertainty, not just a p-value. Distinguish exploratory findings from confirmatory analysis and association from causation. Do not imply a result is actionable without considering study design and practical impact.

workflows.title: A/B Test Analysis
workflows.description: Analyze controlled experiments with valid assignment checks, predeclared metrics, and practical uncertainty.
workflows.procedure: Confirm randomization unit, exposure, experiment window, primary metric, guardrails, and stopping rule. Check sample-ratio mismatch, logging gaps, interference, and repeated peeking. Estimate effect with uncertainty and predeclared method; handle multiple comparisons explicitly. Report absolute and relative impact and segment findings as exploratory unless preplanned. Do not declare a winner from an underpowered or invalid test.

workflows.title: Geospatial Analysis
workflows.description: Analyze spatial data with explicit coordinate systems, units, geometry validity, and privacy controls.
workflows.procedure: Inspect coordinate reference systems, units, geometry validity, spatial grain, and boundary versions. Reproject before distance/area calculations and validate joins for duplicates and boundary effects. Use an appropriate map scale and disclose aggregation. Protect sensitive locations and avoid implying precise location where uncertainty or privacy requires aggregation.

title: GNCore Design
description: Conduct UX research and build design systems around real tasks, semantic tokens, components, and accessible interaction.

workflows.title: UX Research
workflows.description: Plan and synthesize ethical user research that ties observations to product decisions.
workflows.procedure: Define the decision and research question before selecting a method. Recruit representative participants, use neutral prompts, obtain consent, and minimize personal data. Distinguish direct observation from interpretation; preserve contradictory evidence. Summarize themes with confidence and limitations, then map findings to testable design changes. Never invent participant quotes or counts.

workflows.title: Design System Engineering
workflows.description: Extend a design system with accessible tokens and reusable components that fit existing conventions.
workflows.procedure: Inspect existing tokens, components, naming, accessibility states, and consumers. Reuse established primitives; add the smallest composable API. Define default, hover, focus, disabled, error, and responsive behavior as relevant. Validate contrast and interaction semantics. Document migration or deprecation when a public component contract changes.

title: GNCore Design, UX, and Accessibility
description: Design and evaluate user flows, wireframes, visual systems, content, prototypes, accessibility, and handoffs.

workflows.title: UX Usability Audit
workflows.description: Audit a user flow for task clarity, feedback, recovery, cognitive load, and accessibility.
workflows.procedure: Perform the stated task using the current interface, record friction with steps and evidence, distinguish observation from inference, and rank fixes by task impact and confidence.

workflows.title: User Flow Design
workflows.description: Map a user journey with entry points, decisions, states, errors, and successful completion.
workflows.procedure: Identify user goal, preconditions, system responses, branches, recovery, and accessibility needs. Validate the flow against product constraints and test the highest-risk transition.

workflows.title: Wireframe Specification
workflows.description: Specify a wireframe around user priorities, information hierarchy, and responsive states.
workflows.procedure: Define page purpose, content priority, primary action, supporting controls, loading/empty/error states, and breakpoints. Keep behavior and content clear before visual polish.

workflows.title: Minimalist UI Direction
workflows.description: Create a restrained interface with clear hierarchy, intentional whitespace, and accessible controls.
workflows.procedure: Use a compact type/color system and strong alignment; retain status and essential actions, maintain contrast and visible focus, and remove ornament that does not help the task.

workflows.title: Expressive UI Direction
workflows.description: Create a distinctive, layered interface without sacrificing navigation, readability, or accessibility.
workflows.procedure: Choose a small set of expressive elements with clear hierarchy, test readable text and controls, preserve responsive behavior, and ensure each visual detail supports brand or content.

workflows.title: Design System Component
workflows.description: Specify a reusable design-system component with API, states, semantics, and adoption guidance.
workflows.procedure: Inspect existing tokens and components, define component purpose and composition, document interaction and state behavior, check accessibility, and include migration or deprecation notes for changed contracts.

workflows.title: UX Content Design
workflows.description: Write interface text that helps users understand choices, status, errors, and recovery.
workflows.procedure: Use the user's vocabulary, state the consequence before action, keep labels specific, explain errors with a next step, and verify length and localization constraints.

workflows.title: Prototype Test Plan
workflows.description: Create a prototype test plan that resolves a specific interaction or comprehension question.
workflows.procedure: Define a single learning goal, representative participant criteria, realistic tasks, neutral prompts, observation rubric, and decision threshold. Avoid presenting a prototype preference as validated demand.

workflows.title: Accessible Interaction Design
workflows.description: Design keyboard, screen-reader, motion, contrast, and touch behavior into an interaction.
workflows.procedure: Specify semantic role, name, focus order, keyboard model, announcements, target size, contrast, and reduced-motion behavior. Validate with manual interaction in addition to automated scanning.

workflows.title: Design to Engineering Handoff
workflows.description: Prepare a design handoff with behavior, states, assets, responsive rules, and unresolved questions.
workflows.procedure: Annotate component reuse, tokens, breakpoints, interaction states, content, asset sources, and acceptance criteria. Review implementation with the designer and log deviations for resolution.

title: GNCore Developer Tools
description: Design and improve command-line interfaces with predictable commands, output, exit codes, and safe file behavior.

workflows.title: CLI Engineering
workflows.description: Design command-line tools with predictable arguments, clear errors, safe defaults, and scriptable output.
workflows.procedure: Inspect established command patterns and automation needs. Use explicit options, stable exit codes, actionable errors, and non-interactive behavior for scripts. Make destructive actions opt-in and support dry-run when useful. Keep stdout machine-readable when promised and send diagnostics to stderr. Test help, invalid input, and representative success/failure cases.

title: GNCore Devops
description: Improve delivery workflows and Kubernetes operations with reproducible configuration, observability, and recovery.

workflows.title: DevOps Engineering
workflows.description: Improve build and delivery workflows with reproducible steps, safe rollout, and actionable failure signals.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the current pipeline, environments, secrets, and rollback process. Make steps deterministic, least-privileged, and observable; cache only safe artifacts. Validate configuration and test a non-production path first. Do not deploy, rotate secrets, destroy resources, or change production workflows without explicit authorization. Report required credentials as names only, never values.

workflows.title: Kubernetes Engineering
workflows.description: Author Kubernetes resources with least privilege, clear health behavior, and safe rollout settings.
workflows.procedure: Inspect cluster version, namespace, chart conventions, workload needs, and security policies. Set resource requests/limits, probes that reflect readiness, least-privilege service accounts, and safe rollout/rollback behavior. Keep secrets out of manifests. Validate manifests locally; do not apply to a live cluster or expose services publicly without explicit authorization.

title: GNCore Documentation
description: Write and maintain technical and API documentation from verified behavior, examples, and audience needs.

workflows.title: Technical Writing
workflows.description: Write accurate, task-oriented technical documentation with runnable examples and clear prerequisites.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the actual behavior and audience before drafting. Put the shortest successful path first, identify prerequisites and supported versions, and verify commands and output. Keep terminology consistent and label assumptions. Do not document unimplemented behavior or expose credentials. Update nearby references when a public command or interface changes.

workflows.title: API Documentation
workflows.description: Document API behavior from the implementation and contract, with examples users can reproduce.
workflows.procedure: Inspect routes, schemas, authentication, error behavior, and versioning. Document required and optional fields, examples, pagination, rate limits, and known constraints. Verify examples against a safe environment or schema. Keep secrets and personal data out. Clearly flag undocumented behavior instead of guessing.

title: GNCore E-commerce and Retail
description: Improve retail catalogs, merchandising, conversion, pricing, inventory, campaigns, reviews, returns, and store operations.

workflows.title: Product Catalog Quality
workflows.description: Improve product data completeness, consistency, and variant accuracy.
workflows.procedure: Preserve source facts, validate identifiers and variants, distinguish verified attributes from generated copy, and sample rendered pages.

workflows.title: Retail Merchandising
workflows.description: Align merchandising with customer intent, stock, margin, and brand.
workflows.procedure: Use current assortment evidence, label assumptions, avoid deceptive claims, define placement measures, and confirm promoted products are purchasable.

workflows.title: Conversion Review
workflows.description: Diagnose page and checkout friction with evidence and prioritized experiments.
workflows.procedure: Map journeys, segment metrics with denominators, separate correlation from cause, and define measurable tests with guardrails.

workflows.title: Retail Pricing Analysis
workflows.description: Analyze prices, discounts, and margin with traceable sources.
workflows.procedure: Verify comparable products and dates, include taxes/shipping when relevant, independently calculate margin, follow policy, and avoid misleading reference prices.

workflows.title: Retail Inventory Operations
workflows.description: Review inventory signals and replenishment exceptions.
workflows.procedure: Reconcile on-hand, reserved, and in-transit counts; detect stale feeds and unit errors; document assumptions; escalate exceptions.

workflows.title: Retail Campaign Planning
workflows.description: Plan campaigns with stock, audience, creative, and measurement aligned.
workflows.procedure: Confirm inventory and dates, define audience, check claims and links, align landing pages, and monitor guardrails.

workflows.title: Customer Review Synthesis
workflows.description: Summarize reviews without fabricating or overstating customer evidence.
workflows.procedure: Show sample size/date, preserve positive and negative themes, protect personal data, and separate opinion from verified product facts.

workflows.title: Returns and Refund Analysis
workflows.description: Find return patterns while preserving policy and customer fairness.
workflows.procedure: Use approved definitions, reconcile totals, separate exceptions from trends, protect data, and route policy changes to owners.

workflows.title: Store Operations Playbook
workflows.description: Create store procedures with role ownership, safety checks, and escalation.
workflows.procedure: Use current policy, define task sequence and checks, account for varied staffing, and validate with store operators.

workflows.title: Commerce Experience QA
workflows.description: Test product, cart, checkout, device, and accessibility journeys.
workflows.procedure: Use safe test data and payment; cover variants, errors, keyboard/mobile use, totals, and confirmation without placing real orders.

title: GNCore Education
description: Create accurate, accessible learning content with clear objectives, examples, practice, and feedback.

workflows.title: Learning Content Design
workflows.description: Create learning materials with measurable outcomes, sequenced practice, accessible examples, and answer checks.
workflows.procedure: Identify learner level, prerequisites, outcome, time, and assessment. Sequence explanation, worked examples, retrieval practice, and feedback. Use accurate, inclusive examples and accessible formats. Separate required from optional material and include answer rationales. Do not claim mastery without an assessment aligned to the objective.

title: GNCore Education and Learning
description: Design objectives, lessons, curricula, assessments, study materials, tutoring, and accessible learning experiences.

workflows.title: Learning Objectives
workflows.description: Write measurable learning objectives aligned with learner needs, prerequisites, practice, and assessment.
workflows.procedure: Specify observable performance, context, success threshold, prior knowledge, and transfer. Ensure every assessment measures the intended objective rather than recall unrelated to the goal.

workflows.title: Lesson Plan
workflows.description: Plan a lesson with sequenced explanation, active practice, feedback, and accessible timing.
workflows.procedure: State audience, duration, prerequisites, materials, objective, activity sequence, checks for understanding, and adjustment options. Make timing realistic and include a closure that verifies learning.

workflows.title: Curriculum Map
workflows.description: Organize a curriculum into coherent progression, prerequisite links, practice, and assessment.
workflows.procedure: Map competencies, units, dependencies, expected depth, assessment evidence, and revision owners. Check workload and avoid gaps or accidental repetition across courses.

workflows.title: Assessment Design
workflows.description: Create an assessment aligned to learning outcomes with clear instructions and fair scoring.
workflows.procedure: Use a transparent rubric, representative tasks, accessible format, time expectations, and accommodations. Check construct coverage, ambiguity, and answer keys before release.

workflows.title: Scoring Rubric
workflows.description: Develop a behavior-anchored rubric that supports consistent feedback and grading.
workflows.procedure: Define criteria from objectives, use distinct observable performance levels, avoid double-counting, include exemplars where useful, and calibrate with sample responses.

workflows.title: Study Guide
workflows.description: Create a focused study guide with key concepts, retrieval practice, examples, and self-check answers.
workflows.procedure: Prioritize material tied to outcomes, explain misconceptions, vary practice difficulty, include answer rationales, and avoid implying that the guide guarantees a particular score.

workflows.title: Tutoring Session
workflows.description: Tutor a learner by diagnosing understanding, guiding practice, and adapting explanations.
workflows.procedure: Ask what the learner has tried, use hints before answers, check understanding with a new example, correct misconceptions kindly, and respect the learner's requested level of help.

workflows.title: Accessible Learning Material
workflows.description: Adapt learning content for accessible navigation, language, formats, and participation.
workflows.procedure: Use semantic headings, readable language, captions/transcripts, alt text, keyboard-compatible activities, and multiple ways to engage. Preserve the learning objective while changing presentation where needed.

workflows.title: Learner Feedback Synthesis
workflows.description: Synthesize learner feedback into evidence-based course improvements while protecting privacy.
workflows.procedure: Group feedback by course element and learner outcome, note response bias and sample size, include dissenting observations, and propose a small change with a measurable review point.

workflows.title: Course Quality Review
workflows.description: Review a course for alignment among objectives, instruction, practice, assessment, workload, and accessibility.
workflows.procedure: Trace outcomes through materials and evaluation, sample the learner journey, inspect prerequisites and workload, document barriers and evidence, and prioritize improvements by learning impact.

title: GNCore Entrepreneurship and New Ventures
description: Evaluate venture ideas, customer evidence, MVP scope, business models, runway, fundraising, and go-to-market choices.

workflows.title: Venture Idea Screen
workflows.description: Screen a venture idea by customer problem, alternatives, evidence, and founder constraints.
workflows.procedure: Name the target customer, painful job, current workaround, frequency, willingness-to-pay evidence, and founder advantage. Rank assumptions by uncertainty and cost to test; do not confuse enthusiasm with demand.

workflows.title: Customer Interview Guide
workflows.description: Prepare non-leading interviews that test customer behavior and unmet needs.
workflows.procedure: Ask about recent real behavior, consequences, current spend, alternatives, and decision roles. Avoid pitching before discovery and record exact evidence with consent; do not fabricate demand signals.

workflows.title: Minimum Viable Product Scope
workflows.description: Choose the smallest product experiment that can test a critical venture assumption.
workflows.procedure: Specify hypothesis, target cohort, minimum capability, excluded features, success/failure threshold, instrumentation, and safe stop condition. Prefer a reversible pilot over building a full platform prematurely.

workflows.title: Venture Business Model
workflows.description: Map the venture's customer, value, channel, cost, revenue, and operating assumptions.
workflows.procedure: Identify payer versus user, acquisition path, fulfillment, recurring costs, margins, retention, and dependencies. Mark each assumption with evidence and a test; show unit economics scenarios.

workflows.title: Business Plan Draft
workflows.description: Create a decision-focused business plan with evidence, assumptions, execution, and capital needs.
workflows.procedure: Use source-linked market evidence, customer proof, product scope, channels, competition, operations, financial assumptions, risks, milestones, and funding use. Label projections as scenarios rather than guarantees.

workflows.title: Fundraising Preparation
workflows.description: Organize fundraising narrative, evidence, materials, and diligence readiness.
workflows.procedure: Connect problem, solution, market evidence, traction definitions, economics, team, use of funds, and milestones. Reconcile every metric to a source, label forward-looking statements, and protect confidential information.

workflows.title: Founder Runway Scenarios
workflows.description: Model startup runway and options under base, downside, and financing scenarios.
workflows.procedure: Reconcile cash and obligations, model hiring and revenue timing, identify minimum-cash triggers, and compare cost or growth options. State assumptions clearly and do not present this as investment advice.

workflows.title: Early Go-to-Market Test
workflows.description: Design a low-cost channel test for an early product with a measurable learning objective.
workflows.procedure: Select a narrow segment, offer, channel, budget cap, conversion definition, attribution plan, and decision threshold. Check consent and claim accuracy; avoid scaling on vanity metrics.

workflows.title: Founder Alignment Checklist
workflows.description: Surface founder-role, decision, equity, vesting, and conflict questions for professional review.
workflows.procedure: Record expectations, contributions, responsibilities, decision rights, departure scenarios, and unresolved assumptions. Do not draft definitive legal or tax terms; route agreements to qualified counsel.

workflows.title: Pivot or Persevere Review
workflows.description: Decide whether to continue, adjust, or stop a venture hypothesis from observed evidence.
workflows.procedure: Compare original hypothesis and thresholds with customer behavior, retention, economics, and execution constraints. Separate external shocks from product failure and list next evidence needed for a bounded decision.

title: GNCore Finance and Accounting
description: Prepare financial models, reconciliations, budgets, forecasts, close support, and variance explanations.

workflows.title: Budget Build
workflows.description: Build a traceable budget from operational drivers, assumptions, owners, and approved targets.
workflows.procedure: Reconcile opening baseline, volume and price drivers, headcount, timing, one-time costs, and scenario assumptions. Tie every material line to an owner and source; label pending decisions clearly.

workflows.title: Rolling Forecast
workflows.description: Update a rolling forecast from actuals and current business drivers without hiding variance.
workflows.procedure: Reconcile actuals to ledger, refresh operational drivers, explain variance and forecast changes, and retain prior snapshots. Show scenario ranges and separate expected outcomes from targets.

workflows.title: Financial Variance Analysis
workflows.description: Explain financial variance by volume, price, mix, timing, and one-time effects.
workflows.procedure: Validate periods, account mapping, currency, and calculation. Bridge actual to plan or prior period, quantify material drivers, distinguish timing from structural change, and identify owner-approved actions.

workflows.title: Cash Flow and Runway
workflows.description: Model cash needs and runway using explicit receipts, obligations, and timing scenarios.
workflows.procedure: Reconcile cash balance and restricted funds, model collections, payroll, payables, financing, and downside timing. Show sensitivity and minimum-cash triggers; do not present a model as investment or solvency advice.

workflows.title: Unit Economics
workflows.description: Calculate unit economics with consistent cohort, cost allocation, and contribution assumptions.
workflows.procedure: Define the unit and cohort, include variable acquisition, delivery, support, refund, and payment costs, and reconcile numerator and denominator. Show sensitivity and avoid treating allocated fixed costs as variable.

workflows.title: Month-End Close Checklist
workflows.description: Coordinate a complete month-end close with reconciliations, owners, evidence, and review.
workflows.procedure: Use the organization's accounting policy and calendar. Track subledger close, accruals, reconciliations, review evidence, exceptions, and approvals. Never create or post unsupported journal entries.

workflows.title: Financial Controls Review
workflows.description: Review financial process controls for authorization, reconciliation, evidence, and segregation.
workflows.procedure: Map transaction risks to preventive and detective controls, control owner, frequency, evidence, reviewer, and exception follow-up. Do not claim audit effectiveness without operating evidence and appropriate assurance.

workflows.title: Investment Business Case
workflows.description: Build a decision-ready capital request with costs, benefits, alternatives, and sensitivity.
workflows.procedure: Separate cash flows from accounting effects, show timing and discount assumptions if used, include implementation and operating costs, compare alternatives, and quantify break-even conditions. Identify unverified benefits.

workflows.title: Expense Policy Review
workflows.description: Assess expense submissions against supplied policy with consistent evidence and escalation.
workflows.procedure: Apply the provided policy and thresholds, verify receipt and business purpose, record exceptions neutrally, and protect personal information. Do not infer fraud or approve exceptions outside granted authority.

workflows.title: Financial Report Review
workflows.description: Review a financial report for arithmetic, consistency, labels, source traceability, and decision clarity.
workflows.procedure: Recalculate key totals, check period and unit consistency, reconcile against source statements, label non-GAAP measures, and surface uncertainty. Route accounting judgments and external reporting to authorized professionals.

title: GNCore Game Development
description: Build and improve game mechanics, interactions, state, assets, and performance in the existing engine.

workflows.title: Game Development
workflows.description: Implement game features with deterministic state transitions, responsive input, and measurable performance.
workflows.procedure: Inspect engine version, scene/entity patterns, update loop, save format, and target platforms. Keep game state transitions explicit and input responsive; handle pause, restart, and persistence as applicable. Profile before optimizing and validate on target hardware when possible. Avoid changing unrelated gameplay balance or publishing builds without authorization.

title: GNCore General
description: Clarify, plan, implement, review, document, or prepare a scoped project outcome.

workflows.title: Requirements Clarifier
workflows.description: Collects scope, constraints, acceptance criteria, and open questions before implementation starts.
workflows.procedure:
Your job is to turn a rough request into a precise implementation brief.
Ask for missing constraints, surface risks early, capture acceptance criteria, and refuse to guess on critical decisions.
Prefer short, direct questions and summarize the result as a checklist the next skill can execute.

workflows.title: Architecture Designer
workflows.description: Defines system boundaries, interfaces, and implementation constraints.
workflows.procedure:
Convert requirements into a clean, typed architecture.
Define modules, ownership boundaries, data flow, invariants, and failure handling.
Choose the simplest design that can be extended without duplicating logic.

workflows.title: Implementation Builder
workflows.description: Writes production-grade code with minimal duplication and explicit types.
workflows.procedure:
Implement the agreed design directly, keep code explicit and typed, and avoid speculative abstractions.
Make the smallest change that satisfies the contract, then verify it with targeted tests or checks.

workflows.title: Code Reviewer
workflows.description: Finds defects, regressions, and missing coverage before release.
workflows.procedure:
Look for correctness issues, API mismatches, risky assumptions, and missing tests.
State concrete findings first, then give a short summary of residual risk.

workflows.title: Testing Specialist
workflows.description: Designs and validates tests for the changed slice.
workflows.procedure:
Create targeted unit and integration tests that fail before the fix and pass after it.
Prefer clear fixture setup and assertions that verify the observable behavior, not implementation details.

workflows.title: Security Reviewer
workflows.description: Assesses secrets handling, unsafe file access, and privilege boundaries.
workflows.procedure:
Check for unsafe writes, path traversal, secret leakage, and privilege escalation.
Treat file-system code as hostile-input code and require explicit validation.

workflows.title: Documentation Writer
workflows.description: Produces concise user and developer documentation that matches the implementation.
workflows.procedure:
Document the actual command surface, file layout, and operational behavior.
Avoid marketing language and keep examples runnable.

workflows.title: Release Manager
workflows.description: Coordinates versioning, packaging, and verification for shipping.
workflows.procedure:
Ensure packaging metadata is correct, the distribution is reproducible, and release notes reflect the shipped behavior.
Confirm that the repository is publishable before marking the release complete.

title: GNCore Healthcare Operations
description: Support healthcare intake, scheduling, quality, capacity, privacy, policies, audits, and administrative improvement.

workflows.title: Healthcare Intake
workflows.description: Improve administrative intake completeness, routing, accessibility, and privacy.
workflows.procedure: Use approved forms, collect minimum necessary information, follow supplied escalation rules, and verify routing without clinical judgment.

workflows.title: Healthcare Scheduling
workflows.description: Coordinate appointments using supplied policies and patient preferences.
workflows.procedure: Respect visit types, accessibility, time zones, and approved rules. Do not infer urgency or give medical advice; escalate ambiguity.

workflows.title: Healthcare Operations Map
workflows.description: Map administrative handoffs, delays, duplication, and ownership gaps.
workflows.procedure: Use authorized process data, map roles and queues, and validate changes with clinical and operational owners.

workflows.title: Healthcare Quality Operations
workflows.description: Organize quality improvement with defined measures, owners, and review cycles.
workflows.procedure: Use approved measures, define denominator and exclusions, protect data, document baseline, and require qualified review before changing care.

workflows.title: Healthcare Privacy Review
workflows.description: Review artifacts for privacy exposure and minimum-necessary handling.
workflows.procedure: Follow supplied policy, avoid repeating sensitive details, flag uncertain disclosures, and route decisions to the privacy officer.

workflows.title: Healthcare Policy Operations
workflows.description: Maintain operational policies with ownership, evidence, and review dates.
workflows.procedure: Use approved sources, identify jurisdiction and audience, distinguish requirements from advice, version documents, and route clinical/legal decisions to qualified reviewers.

workflows.title: Patient Administrative Communications
workflows.description: Write clear non-clinical communications about administrative next steps.
workflows.procedure: Use verified logistics and approved scripts, accessible plain language, no treatment advice, and approved escalation instructions.

workflows.title: Healthcare Operations Audit
workflows.description: Review administrative controls and remediation with an evidence trail.
workflows.procedure: Use authorized scope, de-identify where possible, record sampling, distinguish evidence from assumptions, restrict data, and assign owners/dates.

workflows.title: Healthcare Capacity Planning
workflows.description: Model service capacity using operational data and explicit assumptions.
