workflows.procedure: Define demand, service time, coverage, constraints, and uncertainty; avoid patient-level inference and have operations validate safety.

workflows.title: Healthcare Improvement Cycle
workflows.description: Plan and assess a bounded operational improvement with safeguards.
workflows.procedure: Set baseline, aim, intervention, balancing measures, approvals, and review date. Monitor unintended effects and follow supplied stop rules.

title: GNCore Legal and Compliance Support
description: Organize legal intake, contract obligations, compliance evidence, policy gaps, and review materials.

workflows.title: Contract Review Intake
workflows.description: Extract obligations, deadlines, and questions from a supplied contract for counsel review.
workflows.procedure: Identify document version, parties, term, payment, termination, liability, data, and governing-law clauses with section references. Flag ambiguity as a question; do not determine enforceability or provide jurisdiction-specific advice.

workflows.title: Obligation Tracker
workflows.description: Turn contract or policy text into traceable obligations, owners, dates, and evidence.
workflows.procedure: Capture exact source clause, obligation, trigger, owner, due date, evidence, dependencies, and uncertainty. Preserve original wording where interpretation matters and route unclear duties to counsel.

workflows.title: Compliance Gap Assessment
workflows.description: Compare supplied controls or evidence against a named policy or framework requirement.
workflows.procedure: Use the exact provided version and requirement IDs, link each conclusion to evidence, and label not assessed versus unmet. Do not claim certification, legal compliance, or audit assurance from a desk review.

workflows.title: Privacy Review Intake
workflows.description: Structure a privacy review by mapping purpose, data, access, retention, and user impact.
workflows.procedure: Trace data source, purpose, categories, recipients, access, storage, retention, deletion, and user rights. Minimize personal data and route legal bases and jurisdiction conclusions to qualified privacy counsel.

workflows.title: Regulatory Change Brief
workflows.description: Summarize a supplied regulatory update and identify affected business processes for expert review.
workflows.procedure: Verify source authority, publication and effective dates, jurisdiction, affected entities, and text version. Separate quoted requirements from operational interpretation and flag legal questions for counsel.

workflows.title: Legal Hold Coordination Checklist
workflows.description: Organize a preservation checklist from authorized instructions without altering source records.
workflows.procedure: Record custodian scope, systems, date ranges, preservation owner, acknowledgments, and exceptions from the supplied legal direction. Do not delete, modify, or independently decide when a hold begins or ends.

workflows.title: Marketing Claims Review
workflows.description: Trace public claims to substantiation and flag claims needing legal or regulatory review.
workflows.procedure: Inventory exact claim, audience, channel, evidence, qualification, expiry, and owner. Distinguish substantiation gaps from legal conclusions and do not publish or approve claims.

workflows.title: Corporate Records Checklist
workflows.description: Organize entity governance records and upcoming filing or approval actions from supplied records.
workflows.procedure: Identify entity, record type, jurisdiction, period, source, custodian, deadline, and required approver. Flag missing records and verify filing duties with the responsible professional.

workflows.title: Dispute Chronology
workflows.description: Build a source-linked chronology from supplied dispute materials for counsel review.
workflows.procedure: Normalize dates and time zones, quote or summarize only necessary text, preserve source IDs, distinguish allegations from established facts, and note gaps or contradictory accounts. Protect privilege and confidentiality.

workflows.title: Legal Review Memo Support
workflows.description: Draft a neutral issue-and-evidence memo for a qualified lawyer to review.
workflows.procedure: State the question, jurisdiction if supplied, relevant source text, facts assumed, competing interpretations, missing evidence, and questions for counsel. Do not conclude legal rights or replace professional advice.

title: GNCore Machine Learning
description: Develop reproducible machine-learning workflows from data preparation and training to evaluation, optimization, and serving.

workflows.title: Machine Learning Workflow
workflows.description: Develop a scoped machine learning feature, from data inspection and baseline selection through evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Help with the machine learning task the user describes. Inspect available data, code, and constraints before choosing an approach. Explain the baseline and evaluation metric, preserve reproducibility, and avoid leaking target information. Keep changes limited to the requested workflow. Do not download data, train expensive models, alter production pipelines, or replace existing modeling choices without explicit direction. Report assumptions, results, and limitations.

workflows.title: Model Training
workflows.description: Set up or improve a reproducible model training run with clear configuration, checkpoints, and evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Help carry out the model training task the user describes. Inspect the current training code and hardware/runtime constraints first. Prefer a small reproducible configuration, explicit seeds where supported, documented data splits, and an evaluation step. Do not launch long or costly training jobs, overwrite checkpoints, change datasets, or modify deployment settings unless the user explicitly requests it. Make the smallest relevant code change and explain how to run the training command.

workflows.title: Train a Machine Learning Model
workflows.description: Build and run a reproducible model training workflow with a baseline, tracked configuration, and held-out evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the dataset, task, framework, hardware, and existing pipeline before editing. Establish a simple baseline and define the target metric first. Split by entity or time when random splitting would leak information; fit preprocessing on training data only. Make seeds, hyperparameters, data version, and checkpoints explicit. Implement the requested training path, but do not launch costly or long-running jobs, download data, overwrite checkpoints, or alter production resources without clear authorization. Report the exact command, observed metrics, artifacts, and limitations; never fabricate a completed run.

workflows.title: Preprocess Machine Learning Data
workflows.description: Design a repeatable preprocessing pipeline that preserves schema, prevents leakage, and records transformations.
workflows.procedure: Inspect schema, units, missingness, target definition, split strategy, and downstream model assumptions. Create deterministic transformations fit only on training data and reuse them unchanged on validation/test data. Preserve source data; make output paths explicit and avoid silent row drops, target leakage, or irreversible coercion. Test edge cases and document each transformation, resulting schema, and unresolved data-quality issue.

workflows.title: Evaluate a Model
workflows.description: Evaluate model quality with leakage-safe splits, task-appropriate metrics, baselines, and error analysis.
workflows.procedure: Confirm the prediction target, intended use, split boundaries, class balance, and decision costs. Compare against a simple baseline using metrics suited to the task; report uncertainty or repeated-split variation where practical. Keep test data untouched during tuning. Inspect segment performance and representative errors without exposing sensitive examples. Distinguish measured results from estimates, state data and compute limits, and never claim fairness, robustness, or production readiness from one aggregate score.

workflows.title: Improve a Machine Learning Model
workflows.description: Find evidence-based model improvements through error analysis and controlled experiments against a fixed baseline.
workflows.procedure: Start from the current baseline, metric, split, and failure examples. Rank likely improvements by evidence, expected impact, and cost; change one factor per experiment where possible. Keep the evaluation set fixed and avoid tuning on test data. Track config, seed, data version, metrics, and compute. Do not run expensive experiments, replace a working model, or change serving behavior without authorization. Report wins, regressions, uncertainty, and the next best experiment.

workflows.title: ML Data Preparation
workflows.description: Prepare reproducible model datasets while preventing leakage and preserving provenance.
workflows.procedure: Inspect schema, label definition, missingness, duplicates, time boundaries, and source provenance before transformation. Split data before fitting learned preprocessing; keep related users, groups, or time periods together when required. Never silently drop rows or labels. Record transformations and counts so the run can be reproduced.

workflows.title: Feature Engineering
workflows.description: Build features that are valid at prediction time and reproducible across training and inference.
workflows.procedure: For every candidate feature, state its source, type, availability time, and transformation. Reject features unavailable at prediction time. Fit statistics only on training data, keep train/serve transformations consistent, and compare against a baseline using the same split and metric. Add complexity only when evaluation supports it.

workflows.title: Model Fine-Tuning
workflows.description: Plan or implement a parameter-efficient or full fine-tuning workflow with controlled data and cost.
workflows.procedure: Confirm the base model, license constraints, data rights, objective, validation method, hardware, and budget. Inspect existing training code and use the least costly method that can answer the goal. Keep validation data separate, record model and tokenizer revisions, and save to a new checkpoint path. Do not launch paid or long-running jobs without explicit approval.

workflows.title: Model Evaluation
workflows.description: Evaluate model quality with valid splits, suitable metrics, uncertainty, and error analysis.
workflows.procedure: Choose metrics from the real decision and class balance, not convenience. Keep tuning data separate from final test data, report sample counts and split rules, compare with a baseline, and inspect important error slices. Quantify uncertainty when feasible. Do not present a single score as proof of generalization or fairness.

workflows.title: Reproducible ML Experiments
workflows.description: Make model experiments traceable across code, data, configuration, environment, and artifacts.
workflows.procedure: Capture the source revision, dataset/version, configuration, seed, dependencies, model identifier, metrics, and artifact location. Keep secrets out of logs. Make repeated runs distinguishable and avoid overwriting artifacts. Use the repository's existing tracker; add a new service only when requested.

workflows.title: Model Serving and Inference APIs
workflows.description: Package model inference behind a reliable API with validation, resource limits, and observable behavior.
workflows.procedure: Trace model loading and inference lifecycle, validate inputs and output shapes, set appropriate timeouts and resource limits, and preserve version identity. Handle cold starts and model errors explicitly. Do not deploy, expose endpoints, or change production configuration unless requested. Measure latency and memory before claiming capacity.

workflows.title: PyTorch Training
workflows.description: Implement PyTorch training loops with correct device, optimizer, checkpoint, and evaluation handling.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed PyTorch version and existing dataset/model interfaces. Set train/eval modes correctly, move batches and model to the same device, clear gradients, and use inference mode for evaluation. Save checkpoints atomically to a new path and include enough state to resume when requested. Start with a tiny smoke run before a full run.

workflows.title: TensorFlow and Keras Training
workflows.description: Build TensorFlow/Keras training workflows with explicit data, callbacks, and evaluation behavior.
workflows.procedure: Inspect TensorFlow/Keras version and data pipeline semantics. Keep preprocessing consistent, avoid validation leakage, configure callbacks explicitly, and save to a new artifact path. Check output shapes and a small batch first. Do not assume GPU availability or start a long training run without user approval.

workflows.title: Deep Learning Engineering
workflows.description: Develop deep learning code with explicit tensor shapes, stable optimization, and reproducible evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Inspect framework versions, model inputs/outputs, tensor shapes, precision, memory limits, and baseline. Verify loss/activation compatibility, masking, gradient flow, and train/eval modes. Keep validation data out of gradient updates and log checkpoints with configuration. Do not launch GPU-intensive jobs or replace checkpoints without approval. Diagnose with a tiny batch before scaling.

workflows.title: Natural Language Processing
workflows.description: Build NLP pipelines that respect language, label quality, privacy, and task-specific evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Inspect languages, tokenization, labels, privacy constraints, and intended use. Establish a simple baseline and split by user/document when duplicates could leak. Evaluate per-class and per-language behavior, not only one aggregate metric. Minimize retention of raw text and redact sensitive examples. Treat generated labels as noisy; document model and data provenance. Do not claim factuality or safety from benchmark scores alone.

workflows.title: Computer Vision
workflows.description: Build vision workflows with robust image handling, leakage-safe splits, and task-appropriate evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Inspect image formats, dimensions, labels, duplicate/near-duplicate groups, and provenance. Split by source, person, or scene where needed to prevent leakage. Normalize consistently and validate augmentations preserve labels. Use task-appropriate metrics and inspect representative errors. Protect biometric and personal imagery; do not download, retain, or expose images without authorization.

workflows.title: MLOps and Model Release
workflows.description: Package, register, and monitor models with reproducible artifacts and explicit release gates.
workflows.procedure: Trace training data, code, dependencies, model artifact, evaluation, and serving contract. Define reproducible build metadata, compatibility checks, rollback path, and monitoring for drift and failures. Keep credentials outside artifacts. Do not deploy, promote, or alter production traffic without explicit authorization. Separate offline evidence from live performance and define an owner for alerts.

workflows.title: Machine Learning Experiment Tracking
workflows.description: Make model experiments comparable with consistent splits, metrics, configuration, and artifact provenance.
workflows.procedure: Define the question and baseline before changing code. Record data version, split, code revision, config, seed, environment, metrics, and artifact path for every run. Compare like with like and account for randomness. Keep experiments isolated and avoid overwriting outputs. Do not introduce a tracking service or upload sensitive data without approval.

workflows.title: Feature Engineering Practice
workflows.description: Create leakage-safe, interpretable features that match the model's serving-time information.
workflows.procedure: For each feature, define its meaning, availability time, source, missing-value semantics, and serving computation. Ensure it uses only information available at prediction time. Fit learned transforms on training data; preserve train/serve parity. Check leakage, drift, cardinality, and subgroup effects. Keep feature logic reproducible and document dropped or transformed columns.

workflows.title: Time-Series Modeling
workflows.description: Analyze and forecast time-indexed data with temporal splits, leakage controls, and useful uncertainty.
workflows.procedure: Inspect frequency, time zone, gaps, revisions, horizon, and forecast origin. Use rolling or forward-chaining evaluation, never random splits. Compare with seasonal-naive baselines and ensure every feature is available at forecast time. Report horizon-specific error and uncertainty; avoid extrapolating beyond evidence. Preserve temporal ordering in preprocessing and backtests.

workflows.title: Model Documentation
workflows.description: Document a model's intended use, data provenance, evaluation, limitations, and deployment assumptions.
workflows.procedure: Use only verified project evidence for training data, method, metrics, and provenance. State intended and excluded uses, evaluation setup, subgroup coverage, limitations, monitoring, and update cadence. Mark unknowns plainly. Do not infer consent, representativeness, fairness, or regulatory status without evidence.

workflows.title: Edge and Hardware-Constrained ML
workflows.description: Adapt inference to constrained hardware using measured latency, memory, and accuracy tradeoffs.
workflows.procedure: Identify target processor, runtime, memory, latency, power, and accuracy requirements. Measure an unoptimized baseline on representative inputs. Compare quantization or compression with task metrics and worst-case behavior; verify supported operators and numerical drift. Keep original artifacts and provide a rollback path. Do not claim deployment readiness from desktop measurements.

title: GNCore Marketing and Growth
description: Plan and evaluate positioning, brand, campaigns, content, acquisition, lifecycle, and marketing investment.

workflows.title: Positioning and Messaging
workflows.description: Develop evidence-based positioning for a defined audience and competitive context.
workflows.procedure: Define audience, problem, alternative, differentiated value, proof, and category language. Use customer evidence and test comprehension; do not make claims the product cannot substantiate.

workflows.title: Campaign Plan
workflows.description: Plan a campaign with audience, offer, channels, budget, measurement, and approval gates.
workflows.procedure: Set one business objective, target segment, message, channel sequence, spend, tracking plan, owner, and stop/scale rule. Check consent, brand, accessibility, and legal review needs before launch.

workflows.title: Marketing Content Brief
workflows.description: Brief content creators with audience need, purpose, evidence, voice, format, and success criteria.
workflows.procedure: Specify reader intent, key takeaway, supporting evidence, CTA, channel, length, source material, review owner, and metric. Mark claims requiring verification and avoid filler or unsupported promises.

workflows.title: Search Content Audit
workflows.description: Audit search content for intent match, accuracy, technical discoverability, and useful next actions.
workflows.procedure: Inspect target query intent, page accuracy, internal links, metadata, indexability, and performance evidence. Recommend updates that improve reader value; never promise rankings or stuff keywords.

workflows.title: Lifecycle Messaging
workflows.description: Design lifecycle messages that help users reach a meaningful product outcome.
workflows.procedure: Map user state, trigger, helpful message, timing, frequency cap, opt-out, and success metric. Respect consent and user control; test holdouts where feasible and monitor complaints and unintended pressure.

workflows.title: Marketing Attribution Review
workflows.description: Interpret marketing contribution while exposing attribution model limitations and incrementality.
workflows.procedure: Reconcile event and spend sources, attribution window, identity coverage, channel overlap, and missing data. Separate attributed conversions from incremental lift and state sensitivity to the model.

workflows.title: Brand Consistency Review
workflows.description: Review brand execution for message consistency, audience fit, accessibility, and evidence.
workflows.procedure: Compare assets to approved positioning, voice, visual system, legal claims, and accessibility needs. Identify inconsistencies with specific evidence and prioritize fixes by audience impact.

workflows.title: Social Media Plan
workflows.description: Create a platform-aware social plan with useful content, response ownership, and risk controls.
workflows.procedure: Set audience, purpose, cadence, format, source, moderation owner, response time, and escalation path. Verify claims and permissions; do not automate sensitive replies or fabricate engagement.

workflows.title: Marketing Budget Allocation
workflows.description: Allocate marketing budget using marginal returns, uncertainty, and strategic coverage.
workflows.procedure: Compare channel-level spend, incremental outcomes, saturation, lag, and confidence. Preserve test budget for unknown channels and model downside; distinguish average historical return from future marginal return.

workflows.title: Go-to-Market Launch
workflows.description: Coordinate market launch readiness across product, pricing, channels, enablement, and customer support.
workflows.procedure: Define segments, value proposition, packaging, channel, launch timing, enablement, proof, service readiness, and feedback loop. Gate external claims on verified product capability and owner approval.

title: GNCore Mobile Development
description: Build mobile application flows with platform-appropriate navigation, state, permissions, accessibility, and lifecycle handling.

workflows.title: Mobile App Engineering
workflows.description: Implement mobile features with reliable navigation, offline behavior, accessibility, and platform conventions.
workflows.procedure: Identify the framework, supported OS versions, navigation, persistence, and permission model first. Follow existing platform conventions and handle loading, empty, error, offline, and denied-permission states. Keep secrets out of the client, minimize collected data, and test small/large screens and accessibility settings. Avoid platform migrations or store submissions unless requested.

title: GNCore Operations
description: Investigate operational incidents and coordinate containment, recovery, communication, and follow-up from evidence.

workflows.title: Incident Response
workflows.description: Triage incidents from evidence, reduce impact safely, and preserve a clear timeline and follow-up.
workflows.procedure: Establish impact, timeline, scope, and current signals from available evidence. Prioritize reversible mitigations and state expected effects before action. Preserve logs and avoid destructive cleanup or speculative changes. Separate facts from hypotheses, assign verification steps, and document recovery criteria and follow-ups. Do not perform live production actions unless explicitly authorized.

title: GNCore PDF Documents
description: Extract, create, combine, split, OCR, fill, review, and verify PDF documents and redactions.

workflows.title: PDF Text and Table Extraction
workflows.description: Extract text or tables from a supplied PDF while preserving page references and uncertainty.
workflows.procedure: Inspect whether the PDF is text-based or scanned, extract with page numbers and table structure, OCR only when needed, compare samples visually, and flag ambiguous characters instead of guessing.

workflows.title: Create a PDF Deliverable
workflows.description: Create a clean PDF from approved source content and verify its page layout and metadata.
workflows.procedure: Preserve source meaning, embed suitable fonts, set page size and margins, verify links and selectable text, render every page, and inspect clipping, blank pages, and reading order.

workflows.title: Accessible PDF Review
workflows.description: Review or improve PDF tags, reading order, headings, links, tables, and alternative text.
workflows.procedure: Check document language, title, tags, heading hierarchy, logical order, table headers, link names, and image descriptions. Run available accessibility checks and manually inspect the reading sequence.

workflows.title: Merge PDFs
workflows.description: Combine approved PDFs in a defined order while preserving page integrity and source provenance.
workflows.procedure: Inventory files and page counts, confirm order and rotation, preserve bookmarks where possible, create a new output without overwriting sources, then render and compare all page boundaries.

workflows.title: Split PDF by Page or Section
workflows.description: Split a PDF into named outputs using explicit page ranges or verified section boundaries.
workflows.procedure: Confirm page numbering convention, validate range boundaries, preserve source file, use descriptive output names, and verify resulting page counts and first/last page content.

workflows.title: PDF Form Workflow
workflows.description: Inspect or create a fillable PDF form with labeled fields and reliable save behavior.
workflows.procedure: Map each field to purpose and data type, add labels and tab order, test keyboard entry and saving, verify printed output, and protect personal information in test fixtures.

workflows.title: Scanned PDF OCR
workflows.description: Make a scanned PDF searchable with OCR and verify text against original page images.
workflows.procedure: Detect scan quality, orientation, language, and page bounds; OCR to a searchable layer without replacing the original image; sample-check names, numbers, columns, and every critical field.

workflows.title: PDF Redaction Review
workflows.description: Apply and verify permanent redaction to specifically authorized PDF content.
workflows.procedure: Confirm exact target and authorization, use true redaction rather than visual overlays, remove hidden text and metadata where required, save a new copy, and inspect extraction and rendered pages for residual content.

workflows.title: PDF Content and Layout Review
workflows.description: Review PDF content, links, references, page numbering, and rendered layout before delivery.
workflows.procedure: Check every page for clipping, missing glyphs, blank pages, inconsistent numbering, broken links, and cross-reference errors. Compare critical facts to the source document.

workflows.title: PDF Signature Workflow Support
workflows.description: Prepare a PDF for an authorized signature workflow and verify fields and final artifact integrity.
workflows.procedure: Identify required signer sequence and field locations from supplied instructions, preserve document content, check certificate or platform requirements, and do not sign or attest on anyone's behalf.

title: GNCore People and Human Resources
description: Support role design, hiring, onboarding, development, performance, workforce planning, and employee policies.

workflows.title: Role Design
workflows.description: Define a role around outcomes, decision rights, essential skills, and fair selection criteria.
workflows.procedure: Separate must-have capabilities from trainable preferences, define measurable outcomes and interfaces, and check language for unnecessary barriers. Align level and compensation range to the organization's approved framework.

workflows.title: Job Description
workflows.description: Draft an inclusive, accurate job description from an approved role profile.
workflows.procedure: State purpose, outcomes, responsibilities, essential qualifications, location and working conditions, and application process. Avoid inflated requirements, demographic proxies, or promises not approved by the employer.

workflows.title: Structured Interview Plan
workflows.description: Create a structured interview plan with job-related questions and consistent evaluation anchors.
workflows.procedure: Map each question to a role competency, use equivalent prompts for candidates, define observable scoring anchors, and plan accommodations. Avoid protected or irrelevant personal questions and calibrate interviewers.

workflows.title: Employee Onboarding Plan
workflows.description: Plan a role-specific onboarding path with access, learning, relationships, and early outcomes.
workflows.procedure: Coordinate manager, IT, security, HR, and team responsibilities; sequence access safely; set first-month goals and check-ins. Confirm completion with the employee and avoid granting excessive permissions by default.

workflows.title: Development Plan
workflows.description: Create a practical employee development plan linked to goals, strengths, and supported practice.
workflows.procedure: Use employee input and role expectations, define one or two observable growth outcomes, provide practice and coaching, and set review dates. Keep feedback specific, respectful, and confidential.

workflows.title: Performance Review Support
workflows.description: Organize performance evidence into a fair, specific, and balanced review draft.
workflows.procedure: Use the organization's criteria and review period, cite observed outcomes, include context and employee perspective, and distinguish facts from interpretation. Do not infer personality or use protected traits.

workflows.title: Workforce Plan
workflows.description: Forecast workforce capacity and skills against business demand and approved scenarios.
workflows.procedure: Model role demand, attrition assumptions, hiring lead time, internal mobility, skills, and cost. Use aggregate data, document uncertainty, and consider reskilling or process alternatives before headcount conclusions.

workflows.title: Engagement Survey Analysis
workflows.description: Analyze employee feedback responsibly while protecting confidentiality and avoiding false precision.
workflows.procedure: Check response counts and anonymity thresholds, compare valid cohorts, code comments with a transparent scheme, and report themes with caveats. Avoid deanonymizing small groups or asserting causes from survey correlations.

workflows.title: HR Policy Draft Review
workflows.description: Review an HR policy draft for clarity, internal consistency, accessibility, and escalation needs.
workflows.procedure: Check purpose, scope, definitions, responsibilities, process, exceptions, records, and cross-references. Flag employment-law and jurisdiction questions for qualified counsel; never label the policy legally compliant without review.

workflows.title: Employee Offboarding Checklist
workflows.description: Coordinate a respectful offboarding with access, knowledge transfer, property, records, and final responsibilities.
workflows.procedure: Follow approved timelines and policy, coordinate least-privilege access removal, preserve required records, transfer business knowledge, and communicate respectfully. Protect confidentiality and route disputes or legal holds to HR and counsel.

title: GNCore Presentations and PowerPoint
description: Create and refine presentations with a clear storyline, visual hierarchy, accurate charts, and verified layouts.

workflows.title: Presentation Storyline
workflows.description: Turn an audience, decision, and evidence set into a coherent presentation narrative.
workflows.procedure: Define audience, purpose, one takeaway, decision requested, and time limit. Order claims as a logical story, support each with evidence, and remove slides that do not advance the outcome.

workflows.title: Create a PowerPoint Deck
workflows.description: Create a presentation deck from a brief and source material with a clear storyline and consistent design.
workflows.procedure: Build a slide outline before authoring, use a consistent theme and native editable elements, cite claims, and keep one main point per slide. Export/render every slide and fix overflow, clipping, and weak contrast.

workflows.title: Executive Presentation
workflows.description: Prepare an executive deck that leads with decisions, implications, risks, and evidence.
workflows.procedure: Put the recommendation and decision needed early, show the few metrics that support it with context, include alternatives and risks, and close with owners and next gates.

workflows.title: Data Story Presentation
workflows.description: Explain data in slides with faithful charts, denominators, uncertainty, and a decision-relevant takeaway.
workflows.procedure: Verify chart values against source data, label units and periods, use honest scales, expose uncertainty and exclusions, and narrate association versus causation accurately.

workflows.title: Presentation Visual Design
workflows.description: Improve slide hierarchy, typography, color, alignment, and visual consistency without weakening content.
workflows.procedure: Use the supplied brand system, align repeated elements, maintain readable type and contrast, avoid decorative clutter, and inspect slides at presentation size and on a rendered overview.

workflows.title: Edit an Existing PPTX
workflows.description: Revise an existing deck while preserving intended content, theme, and editable structure.
workflows.procedure: Inspect slide masters, layouts, notes, charts, and embedded media before editing. Make scoped changes, preserve source, render the whole deck, and compare changed and neighboring slides for layout regressions.

workflows.title: Speaker Notes and Talk Track
workflows.description: Write speaker notes that support a timed presentation without duplicating slide text.
workflows.procedure: Estimate speaking time, explain transitions and evidence, mark pauses or demos, and keep notes consistent with slide claims. Check the talk track against the actual exported deck.

workflows.title: Accessible Presentation
workflows.description: Review a presentation for reading order, contrast, meaningful text, captions, and accessible charts.
workflows.procedure: Use logical reading order, descriptive titles and alt text, sufficient contrast, accessible chart labels, and captions for essential audio/video. Validate using built-in checking and manual slide review.

workflows.title: PowerPoint Template Design
workflows.description: Create a reusable PowerPoint template with reliable masters, layouts, typography, and color tokens.
workflows.procedure: Define purpose-specific layouts and theme tokens, test short and long titles, charts and images, check placeholders and footers, and create a sample deck to verify editability and rendering.

workflows.title: PowerPoint Deck QA
workflows.description: Run a final slide-by-slide quality pass on a saved presentation and its exported PDF.
workflows.procedure: Check slide order, duplicated or missing content, citations, spelling, notes, links, image quality, embedded media, dimensions, and rendering. Open both final artifacts and report defects by slide number.

title: GNCore Procurement and Vendor Management
description: Prepare sourcing requirements, RFPs, vendor comparisons, due diligence, negotiations, and vendor lifecycle plans.

workflows.title: Procurement Requirements
workflows.description: Translate a business need into measurable, vendor-neutral procurement requirements.
workflows.procedure: Separate mandatory outcomes from preferences, define acceptance evidence, service levels, security/privacy needs, accessibility, support, and lifecycle cost. Avoid requirements that unfairly lock the process to one vendor.

workflows.title: RFP Package
workflows.description: Prepare a fair request for proposal with scope, scoring, schedule, and response instructions.
workflows.procedure: Define eligibility, scope, response format, evaluation weights, questions period, decision authority, and conflicts process. Ensure each criterion is testable and consistently applied; route terms to procurement and counsel.

workflows.title: Vendor Scorecard
workflows.description: Score supplier proposals against published criteria with evidence and consistent normalization.
workflows.procedure: Use the same rubric for each bidder, cite response evidence, separate evaluator judgment from facts, disclose conflicts, and record unanswered requirements. Do not adjust weights after viewing results without governance approval.

workflows.title: Total Cost of Ownership
workflows.description: Compare vendor options across implementation, usage, support, renewal, exit, and risk costs.
workflows.procedure: Normalize contract periods, units, volumes, currency, discount assumptions, implementation, integration, training, support, and exit costs. Show sensitivity and distinguish quoted amounts from estimated costs.

workflows.title: Supplier Due Diligence
workflows.description: Coordinate risk-based supplier due diligence across security, privacy, finance, and continuity.
workflows.procedure: Apply supplied policy, risk tier, evidence date, scope, reviewer, and unresolved issue. Do not accept attestations as proof of controls; escalate critical gaps and avoid collecting unnecessary personal data.

workflows.title: Supplier Negotiation Plan
workflows.description: Prepare negotiation priorities and fallback options within approved procurement authority.
workflows.procedure: Rank business needs, service protections, commercial levers, alternatives, approval limits, and tradeable concessions. Do not accept terms or bind the organization; route redlines to authorized signers and counsel.

workflows.title: Supplier Onboarding
workflows.description: Coordinate supplier onboarding with least-privilege access, ownership, and required control evidence.
workflows.procedure: Confirm business sponsor, approved scope, contract status, data access, security review, payment setup, integrations, and renewal owner. Do not grant production access before required approvals are documented.

workflows.title: Supplier Performance Review
workflows.description: Review vendor service against contracted outcomes, service levels, and corrective actions.
workflows.procedure: Reconcile source telemetry to contractual measures and reporting window, record exclusions and incidents, assess trend and customer impact, and track owner/date for each remediation.

workflows.title: Vendor Renewal Review
workflows.description: Make a renewal decision using value, risk, alternatives, usage, and notice deadlines.
workflows.procedure: Verify notice windows and contract terms, adoption and realized value, service incidents, price changes, dependency and exit cost. Present renew, renegotiate, replace, or exit options with owners and deadlines.

workflows.title: Supplier Exit Plan
workflows.description: Plan a controlled supplier transition that protects service, data, access, and records.
workflows.procedure: Map data export and deletion, credentials, integrations, user migration, dependencies, service overlap, and acceptance evidence. Assign accountable owners, sequence reversible steps, and verify exit obligations with counsel.

title: GNCore Product
description: Investigate user problems and validate product opportunities before committing to a solution.

workflows.title: Product Discovery
workflows.description: Turn a product idea into a testable problem statement, user evidence plan, and scoped first release.
workflows.procedure: Separate user problem, evidence, assumptions, and proposed solution. Identify target users, current alternatives, constraints, and measurable outcome. Rank unknowns by risk and propose the cheapest test that can resolve them. Define a narrow first release with explicit exclusions and acceptance criteria. Do not present guesses as user research.

title: GNCore Product Management
description: Discover product opportunities and turn them into requirements, experiments, roadmaps, and launch decisions.

workflows.title: Product Opportunity Brief
workflows.description: Turn customer and business evidence into a scoped product opportunity.
workflows.procedure: Define the user, unmet need, current workaround, evidence, strategic fit, expected outcome, alternatives, and top unknowns. Separate interview observations from assumptions and propose the cheapest useful validation.

workflows.title: Product Requirements
workflows.description: Write testable product requirements and acceptance criteria for a scoped feature.
workflows.procedure: Specify actors, outcomes, constraints, functional behavior, edge cases, accessibility, privacy, and success measures. Flag conflicts and unresolved decisions; avoid prescribing implementation unless it is a product constraint.

workflows.title: Product Roadmap
workflows.description: Build an outcome-led roadmap that exposes dependencies, confidence, and trade-offs.
workflows.procedure: Connect roadmap themes to strategic outcomes and customer evidence. Show confidence, sequence, dependencies, capacity, and deliberate non-goals; avoid presenting speculative dates as commitments.

workflows.title: Product Discovery Sprint
workflows.description: Plan a short discovery cycle that resolves the riskiest product assumptions.
workflows.procedure: State the decision to make, riskiest assumptions, research method, participant criteria, prototype, evidence threshold, and decision date. Keep discovery methods ethical and avoid claiming validation from weak samples.

workflows.title: Feature Prioritization
workflows.description: Prioritize feature requests using customer value, evidence, cost, and strategic fit.
workflows.procedure: Normalize requests into underlying needs, estimate reach and impact with confidence, include engineering and maintenance cost, and identify opportunity cost. Record the rationale and revisit when evidence changes.

workflows.title: Product Experiment Design
workflows.description: Design product experiments with a clear hypothesis, metric, guardrails, and decision rule.
workflows.procedure: Define eligible population, assignment unit, exposure, primary outcome, guardrails, duration, sample constraints, and stopping rule. Check for interference, privacy concerns, and instrumentation defects before interpreting results.

workflows.title: Product Launch Readiness
workflows.description: Coordinate launch readiness across product, engineering, support, sales, and communications.
workflows.procedure: Confirm target users, release scope, feature flags, migration, documentation, support coverage, analytics, rollback, and launch owner. Mark every gate as verified, blocked, or not applicable with evidence.

workflows.title: Customer Feedback Synthesis
workflows.description: Synthesize product feedback into traceable themes without overstating frequency.
workflows.procedure: Deduplicate evidence, preserve source and segment, distinguish frequency from severity, and include counterexamples. Link themes to decisions and note sampling bias and unrepresented users.

workflows.title: Product Lifecycle Review
workflows.description: Assess adoption, retention, quality, and investment choices for an existing product.
workflows.procedure: Review cohort behavior, customer value, reliability, support load, cost, strategic relevance, and alternatives. Recommend sustain, improve, migrate, or sunset with customer impact and a reversible transition plan.

workflows.title: Product Metrics Definition
workflows.description: Define a product metric with an unambiguous event, population, denominator, and owner.
workflows.procedure: Specify metric formula, unit, time window, source events, exclusions, segmentation, owner, and known biases. Check that the metric reflects user value and cannot easily be improved by harmful behavior.

title: GNCore Professional Services
description: Prepare contract-review and financial-analysis support with traceable sources, assumptions, and review boundaries.

workflows.title: Legal Document Review Support
workflows.description: Summarize a legal document's structure and flag questions for qualified counsel without giving definitive legal advice.
workflows.procedure: Identify document type, parties, effective date, governing law if stated, and the reviewer's requested focus. Summarize relevant clauses with section references, quote only necessary snippets, and flag ambiguity or unusual obligations as questions. Do not invent missing terms, declare enforceability, or replace jurisdiction-specific advice from a qualified lawyer. Protect confidential material.

workflows.title: Financial Analysis Support
workflows.description: Structure financial calculations and scenarios with transparent inputs, formulas, and sensitivity ranges.
workflows.procedure: Confirm currency, period, accounting basis, source data, and decision context. Show formulas, assumptions, sensitivity, and reconciliation checks. Distinguish historical facts, estimates, and scenarios. Do not fabricate market data or present outputs as personalized investment, tax, or accounting advice. Flag decisions requiring a qualified professional.

title: GNCore Project and Program Management
description: Plan, coordinate, recover, and close projects with explicit dependencies, capacity, and decisions.

workflows.title: Project Charter
workflows.description: Create a concise project charter with outcome, scope, ownership, constraints, and decision gates.
workflows.procedure: Record sponsor, accountable lead, beneficiaries, success criteria, in-scope and excluded work, resources, constraints, risks, and governance. Resolve ambiguous authority and acceptance before execution begins.

workflows.title: Delivery Plan
workflows.description: Build an executable delivery plan with milestones, dependencies, owners, and evidence.
workflows.procedure: Decompose deliverables into verifiable milestones, estimate with ranges, identify dependencies and critical path, assign owners, and define completion evidence. Surface assumptions and contingency rather than hiding schedule uncertainty.

workflows.title: Project Status Brief
workflows.description: Produce a truthful project status update with progress, forecast, risks, and asks.
workflows.procedure: Compare actual progress to baseline using completed evidence, not activity. State schedule and scope variance, confidence, new risks, decisions needed, and next milestone; never convert an estimate into an achieved result.

workflows.title: Project Risk Log
workflows.description: Create and maintain actionable project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
workflows.procedure: Write each item as a cause-event-impact statement with probability, impact, owner, response, trigger, and due date. Separate current issues from future risks and close items only with evidence.

workflows.title: Project Recovery Plan
workflows.description: Recover a troubled project by identifying root causes and rebaselining achievable outcomes.
workflows.procedure: Establish the true state, causes, remaining scope, capacity, dependencies, and stakeholder commitments. Present options with impacts, reset only with sponsor agreement, and define weekly recovery indicators and stop conditions.

workflows.title: Decision Meeting Preparation
workflows.description: Prepare a meeting agenda and decision record that uses participant time effectively.
workflows.procedure: Clarify the decision, decision maker, pre-read, options, evidence gaps, and time allocation. Capture decision, rationale, dissent, owner, due date, and revisit trigger; distinguish discussion from approval.

workflows.title: Dependency Coordination
workflows.description: Map and resolve cross-team dependencies before they become delivery blockers.
workflows.procedure: Identify provider, consumer, contract, needed-by date, confidence, fallback, and escalation path for each dependency. Confirm ownership bilaterally and track changes to interfaces and dates.

workflows.title: Capacity and Resource Plan
workflows.description: Match project demand to available skills, capacity, and protected operational work.
workflows.procedure: Use realistic availability, leave, skills, context switching, and run-work data. Show demand versus capacity by period, expose trade-offs, and avoid treating people as interchangeable capacity units.

workflows.title: Project Retrospective
workflows.description: Run a blameless retrospective that yields specific, owned process improvements.
workflows.procedure: Reconstruct outcomes and contributing conditions from evidence, include multiple perspectives, distinguish systemic causes from individual blame, and assign a small number of measurable experiments with owners and review dates.

workflows.title: Project Closure and Handoff
workflows.description: Close a project with accepted deliverables, operational ownership, records, and lessons.
workflows.procedure: Confirm acceptance, unresolved defects, support ownership, documentation, access, financial close, and records retention. Obtain explicit handoff acceptance and keep post-project work visible.

title: GNCore Python
description: Build, profile, package, and migrate Python libraries while preserving public APIs and supported runtimes.

workflows.title: Python Library Engineering
workflows.description: Design maintainable Python packages with stable APIs, typing, packaging, and clear examples.
workflows.procedure: Inspect supported Python versions, packaging backend, and public imports. Keep public APIs small and backward-compatible unless a breaking change is requested. Use explicit types and focused modules, avoid import-time side effects, declare runtime dependencies accurately, and provide a minimal runnable example. Check wheel and source inclusion rules when packaging changes.

workflows.title: Python Performance
workflows.description: Profile Python hotspots and improve measured runtime or memory without changing semantics.
workflows.procedure: Measure a representative baseline before optimizing. Profile CPU and memory with available tools, identify the dominant hotspot, and optimize that path while preserving outputs and errors. Avoid clever micro-optimizations without evidence. Re-run the same workload and report hardware, input scale, and before/after measurements.

workflows.title: Python Packaging
workflows.description: Package a Python library with clear APIs, reproducible builds, supported versions, and clean installation behavior.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the current build backend, Python support matrix, dependencies, and public API. Keep imports predictable and package data explicit; pin policy should match project conventions. Build and install the artifact in an isolated environment, verify metadata and entry points, and test a clean import. Do not publish a release or change compatibility promises without approval.

workflows.title: Python Upgrade and Migration
workflows.description: Migrate Python code or dependencies in a controlled way with compatibility evidence and a rollback path.
workflows.procedure: Identify the source and target versions, supported users, deprecations, and dependency constraints. Search all call sites, update in small coherent steps, and preserve public behavior unless the request says otherwise. Verify on the supported version matrix where available and document breaking changes. Avoid broad dependency upgrades bundled into the migration.

title: GNCore Quality Assurance
description: Audit accessibility and performance, plan tests, and connect requirements to verifiable acceptance evidence.

workflows.title: Accessibility Audit
workflows.description: Inspect a user flow for keyboard, screen reader, visual, and cognitive accessibility barriers.
workflows.procedure: Walk the actual flow using semantic structure, keyboard only, visible focus, zoom/reflow, labels, errors, and relevant assistive technology when available. Record reproducible steps, affected users, and evidence. Prioritize barriers by impact and task completion. Map findings to applicable criteria only when checked; do not claim full conformance from a partial audit.

workflows.title: Performance Audit
workflows.description: Find and verify the largest performance bottlenecks before changing code or infrastructure.
workflows.procedure: Capture a baseline under stated hardware, data, and load conditions. Profile before optimizing and identify the critical path. Change one bottleneck at a time, preserve correctness, and compare repeated measurements. Include tail latency and resource cost when relevant. Do not claim improvement without measured before/after evidence or scale workload beyond safe limits.

workflows.title: Test Strategy
workflows.description: Choose a balanced test plan that catches important failures at the lowest practical level.
workflows.procedure: Map changed behavior to risks and contracts. Prefer focused unit tests for logic, integration tests for boundaries, and a small number of end-to-end tests for critical journeys. Include failure paths, permissions, and data invariants. Avoid brittle implementation assertions and duplicated coverage. Report what is covered, what is unverified, and the exact commands run.

workflows.title: Requirements to Acceptance Tests
workflows.description: Turn requirements into observable acceptance cases that cover success, failure, boundaries, and permissions.
workflows.procedure: Extract actors, preconditions, inputs, expected outcomes, and constraints. Rewrite vague statements as observable behaviors and identify contradictions or missing decisions. Cover normal, boundary, error, permission, and recovery paths. Link cases to requirement IDs where available. Do not treat implementation details as acceptance criteria unless they are contractual.

title: GNCore Quality Engineering and Testing
description: Design risk-based test strategies, automation, end-to-end and contract checks, and release evidence.

workflows.title: Test Strategy
workflows.description: Choose a risk-based test mix that verifies behavior at the lowest effective level.
workflows.procedure: Map changed contracts and failure costs to unit, integration, end-to-end, accessibility, and performance checks. Prioritize boundary and recovery cases; report untested risk without padding coverage metrics.

workflows.title: Test Case Design
workflows.description: Turn a behavior contract into clear positive, negative, boundary, and state-transition tests.
workflows.procedure: Define preconditions, inputs, observable outcome, oracle, cleanup, and traceability. Use equivalence classes and realistic edge cases; avoid asserting incidental implementation details.

workflows.title: Test Automation
workflows.description: Build maintainable test automation with stable setup, deterministic data, and actionable failures.
workflows.procedure: Use isolated fixtures, explicit waits, stable selectors, safe cleanup, and failure artifacts that exclude secrets. Eliminate flaky timing and rerun failures to distinguish product defects from harness defects.

workflows.title: End-to-End User Journey Test
workflows.description: Verify a critical user journey across the application with realistic but isolated data.
workflows.procedure: Select the highest-value journey, define checkpoints, seed deterministic state, test success and a meaningful failure path, and clean up. Avoid production accounts and fixed sleeps.

workflows.title: API Contract Testing
workflows.description: Check API compatibility, validation, authorization, and error contracts between services.
workflows.procedure: Use versioned schemas and representative consumers, test malformed and unauthorized requests, verify status and error bodies, and detect breaking changes before deployment.

workflows.title: Performance Test Plan
workflows.description: Measure a service against representative load, latency, throughput, and resource objectives.
workflows.procedure: Set workload model, environment, warmup, duration, concurrency, percentiles, and safety limits. Compare repeatable baselines and stop before shared systems are harmed.

workflows.title: Accessibility Test Pass
workflows.description: Test a flow for keyboard operation, semantics, focus, labels, zoom, and assistive technology support.
workflows.procedure: Run automated checks and manual keyboard review, inspect focus and error announcements, test reflow/zoom, and record reproducible barriers. Do not claim full conformance from partial coverage.

workflows.title: Defect Triage
workflows.description: Classify and prioritize a defect using reproducibility, user impact, scope, and workaround evidence.
workflows.procedure: Capture environment, version, steps, expected and actual result, affected users, frequency, and evidence. Separate severity from priority and avoid unsupported root-cause claims.

workflows.title: Release Quality Gate
workflows.description: Evaluate release evidence against agreed quality gates and make residual risk visible.
workflows.procedure: Check required automated and manual evidence, unresolved defects, platform coverage, rollback, and known issues. Mark each gate passed, failed, skipped, or blocked; never equate a green pipeline with zero risk.

workflows.title: Flaky Test Investigation
workflows.description: Find the cause of an intermittent test failure and confirm a stable correction.
workflows.procedure: Collect repeated-run evidence, timestamps, ordering, shared state, network and timing dependencies. Reproduce under controlled conditions, fix the cause rather than suppressing the assertion, and demonstrate stable reruns.

title: GNCore Release Engineering
description: Prepare a software release with consistent versions, tested artifacts, migration notes, and a reviewable delivery plan.

workflows.title: Release Readiness Review
workflows.description: Check a release candidate against explicit acceptance, compatibility, security, rollback, and communication gates.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the release scope, version, changelog, artifacts, compatibility matrix, known issues, and rollback plan. Verify required checks and distinguish passed from skipped. Check migrations and external dependencies for rollout sequencing. Do not publish or deploy without authorization. End with a go/no-go recommendation tied to evidence and unresolved risks.

title: GNCore Research
description: Synthesize evidence into a clear answer with source provenance, uncertainty, and decision-relevant conclusions.

workflows.title: Research Synthesis
workflows.description: Synthesize supplied or sourced evidence with provenance, disagreement, and uncertainty kept visible.
workflows.procedure: Translate the question into scope, date range, and evidence standard. Prioritize primary sources; record citation details and distinguish source claims from your synthesis. Compare methods and note conflicting findings, limitations, and missing evidence. Do not invent citations, quotations, or consensus. State when evidence is insufficient or likely outdated.

title: GNCore Research and Market Intelligence
description: Investigate markets, competitors, customers, literature, surveys, and evidence with traceable sources.

workflows.title: Research Question Design
workflows.description: Frame a researchable question with scope, definitions, evidence criteria, and a useful decision.
workflows.procedure: Define population, concept, time period, geography, inclusion criteria, and decision use. Identify likely source types, bias, and what evidence would disconfirm the working hypothesis.

workflows.title: Source Quality Audit
workflows.description: Evaluate sources for authority, method, date, provenance, conflicts, and fitness for a claim.
workflows.procedure: Trace each source to its publisher and method, check date and scope, inspect primary evidence, note funding/conflicts, and match strength of wording to quality of support.

workflows.title: Literature Review
workflows.description: Synthesize a literature set with methods, findings, disagreement, and evidence gaps visible.
workflows.procedure: Use explicit search and inclusion criteria, extract population/method/outcome/limitations, compare study quality, and avoid vote-counting or treating association as causation.

workflows.title: Market Sizing
workflows.description: Estimate a market using transparent bottom-up or top-down assumptions and sensitivity ranges.
workflows.procedure: Define product, customer, geography, time, and revenue basis; cite input sources; avoid overlapping segments; cross-check methods; and present ranges instead of unsupported point precision.

workflows.title: Customer and Market Research
workflows.description: Combine customer evidence and market signals into actionable, bounded insights.
workflows.procedure: Define segment and sampling, preserve interview or survey provenance, separate stated preference from behavior, include counterexamples, and state what the sample cannot represent.

workflows.title: Competitive Research Brief
workflows.description: Prepare a dated competitor brief from verifiable product, pricing, and positioning evidence.
workflows.procedure: Use public or supplied sources, record observation date, compare like-for-like plans, separate product facts from inferred strategy, and identify uncertainties that affect the decision.

workflows.title: Evidence Map
workflows.description: Organize claims, sources, strength, disagreement, and missing evidence for a decision area.
workflows.procedure: Break broad claims into testable propositions, link each to its strongest source, grade source quality transparently, record contradictions, and mark unsupported claims plainly.

workflows.title: Survey Design and Review
workflows.description: Design a survey with neutral wording, clear constructs, representative sampling, and privacy safeguards.
workflows.procedure: Map each question to a construct and decision, test comprehension, avoid double-barreled or leading items, define response options and sampling, and document nonresponse limits.

workflows.title: Research Brief
workflows.description: Turn research into a concise, sourced brief with answer, confidence, implications, and open questions.
workflows.procedure: Answer the stated question first, cite close to claims, distinguish established findings from synthesis, include limitations and contrary evidence, and identify decision implications and evidence gaps.

workflows.title: Research Update Monitor
workflows.description: Track a defined topic for material source changes without overwhelming users with routine noise.
workflows.procedure: Set scope, source list, review cadence, change threshold, and freshness. Compare new primary evidence with prior conclusions and report only verified material changes and their implications.

title: GNCore Sales and Revenue
description: Research accounts, qualify opportunities, prepare sales conversations, proposals, forecasts, and renewals.

workflows.title: Strategic Account Plan
workflows.description: Create an account plan based on customer outcomes, stakeholders, risks, and verified activity.
workflows.procedure: Summarize customer goals, buying roles, current solution, value hypothesis, relationship evidence, competition, next milestones, and mutual actions. Mark unknown stakeholder views and avoid fabricating customer intent.

workflows.title: Sales Discovery
workflows.description: Prepare neutral discovery questions that uncover customer needs, impact, constraints, and decision process.
workflows.procedure: Tailor questions to the prospect's context, quantify current impact without leading, identify users and approvers, and test urgency and alternatives. Capture direct statements separately from sales interpretation.

workflows.title: Opportunity Qualification
workflows.description: Assess opportunity fit and deal risk using transparent qualification evidence.
workflows.procedure: Evaluate business problem, measurable impact, sponsor, decision process, timing, competition, implementation fit, and next customer-confirmed action. Identify disconfirming signals and do not inflate CRM confidence.

workflows.title: Pipeline Review
workflows.description: Inspect pipeline quality and next-step integrity to improve forecast and coaching.
workflows.procedure: Review stage evidence, aging, amount provenance, buyer engagement, mutual plan, and next step. Flag stale or unsupported opportunities and distinguish pipeline coverage from forecast confidence.

workflows.title: Revenue Forecast
workflows.description: Build a revenue forecast with explicit assumptions, scenarios, and confidence.
workflows.procedure: Reconcile source opportunities and historical conversion, define cutoff and currency, model slippage and risk, and show base/upside/downside. Never present a scenario or quota target as a committed forecast.

workflows.title: Customer Proposal
workflows.description: Draft a customer proposal tied to stated needs, outcomes, scope, assumptions, and evidence.
workflows.procedure: Use confirmed requirements, measurable outcomes, deliverables, exclusions, timeline assumptions, responsibilities, pricing source, and acceptance. Flag unsupported claims and route commercial or legal terms for approval.

workflows.title: Commercial Negotiation Preparation
workflows.description: Prepare negotiation options and concession boundaries grounded in approved commercial policy.
workflows.procedure: Identify customer priorities, our walk-away conditions, value exchange, approval limits, and conditional concessions. Never invent authority, promise unapproved terms, or misrepresent alternatives.

workflows.title: Customer Objection Response
workflows.description: Answer a sales objection with accurate evidence and a useful next question.
workflows.procedure: Clarify the concern, respond only with verified product or service evidence, acknowledge limits, and ask what would resolve the issue. Escalate roadmap, security, legal, or performance claims to an owner.

workflows.title: Territory and Coverage Plan
workflows.description: Balance account coverage and sales capacity across a territory using transparent criteria.
workflows.procedure: Use account potential evidence, segment, workload, geography, existing commitments, and representative capacity. Show assumptions and fairness checks; do not treat proxy data as certain buying intent.

workflows.title: Renewal and Expansion Plan
workflows.description: Protect a renewal by connecting adoption, realized outcomes, risks, and agreed next value.
workflows.procedure: Review usage and outcomes against the customer plan, open issues, stakeholders, renewal dates, and contract facts. Identify at-risk gaps honestly and agree an actionable recovery or expansion path.

title: GNCore Security
description: Review web security and privacy boundaries using concrete code paths, data flows, and source-backed requirements.

workflows.title: Web Security Engineering
workflows.description: Review web features for input, session, authorization, and output-handling vulnerabilities.
workflows.procedure: Trace attacker-controlled values from entry to storage and rendering. Check authentication and object-level authorization on every sensitive operation, output encoding, CSRF protections where relevant, secret handling, and safe error responses. Tie findings to code paths and exploit conditions; do not claim a vulnerability without evidence.

workflows.title: Privacy Review
workflows.description: Reduce privacy risk by tracing personal data, purpose, access, retention, and user control.
workflows.procedure: Map data collected, source, purpose, recipients, storage, access, retention, deletion, and user controls. Identify data minimization and security improvements. Flag jurisdiction-specific legal questions rather than asserting compliance. Do not expose raw personal data in logs, examples, or reports; use synthetic or redacted samples.

title: GNCore Software Engineering
description: Design, implement, debug, review, refactor, migrate, and release scoped software changes.

workflows.title: Software Feature Delivery
workflows.description: Deliver a scoped software feature using local conventions and verifiable acceptance criteria.
workflows.procedure: Trace the feature through interfaces and data flow, define observable behavior, make the smallest coherent change, add boundary tests, and run targeted regressions. Preserve unrelated user work and report exact checks.

workflows.title: Software Architecture Decision
workflows.description: Compare architecture options against constraints, operations, reversibility, and lifecycle cost.
workflows.procedure: Capture context, quality attributes, constraints, alternatives, trade-offs, failure modes, and a decision owner. Prefer incremental reversible choices and validate assumptions with a small implementation where useful.

workflows.title: Software Code Review
workflows.description: Review a code change for correctness, security, maintainability, and missing regression coverage.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the full diff and relevant callers, identify concrete reproducible findings with severity and file locations, and separate defects from preferences. Confirm fixes with targeted regression checks.

workflows.title: Software Debugging
workflows.description: Diagnose a software failure from reproducible evidence and verify the smallest safe fix.
workflows.procedure: Reproduce or isolate the failing condition, inspect logs and state, form testable hypotheses, and narrow the cause before editing. Add a regression test, fix the root cause, and rerun the failure and impacted checks.

workflows.title: Safe Refactoring
workflows.description: Refactor a bounded code area while preserving its documented behavior and public contracts.
workflows.procedure: Capture behavior with tests or characterization, identify callers, make small mechanical steps, and run tests after each risky step. Avoid unrelated redesign and compare externally observable behavior before and after.

workflows.title: Software API Contract
workflows.description: Define and verify an API contract across request, response, errors, versioning, and consumers.
workflows.procedure: Inspect actual consumers, validate schemas and authorization boundaries, specify error semantics and compatibility, and test contract fixtures. Flag breaking behavior and provide a migration path.

workflows.title: Dependency Change Review
workflows.description: Assess and implement a dependency change with compatibility, security, and rollback evidence.
workflows.procedure: Check supported versions, changelog, transitive effects, license policy, lockfile behavior, and known vulnerabilities. Change only needed packages, run affected tests, and record rollback and compatibility results.

workflows.title: Software Performance Optimization
workflows.description: Find a measured software bottleneck and optimize it without regressing correctness.
workflows.procedure: Establish repeatable workload and baseline, profile the critical path, estimate impact and resource trade-offs, then change one bottleneck. Rerun correctness tests and comparable benchmarks; report uncertainty.

workflows.title: Software Migration Plan
workflows.description: Plan a staged migration with compatibility gates, data safety, and rollback criteria.
workflows.procedure: Inventory dependencies and consumers, define target and interim states, map changes and data movement, and stage by reversible boundaries. Test backward compatibility and rollback before production cutover.

workflows.title: Software Release Candidate
workflows.description: Prepare a software release with reproducible artifacts, verified changes, and rollback readiness.
workflows.procedure: Check version, diff, changelog, build provenance, tests, dependency locks, supported platforms, migrations, and known issues. Separate passed, skipped, and blocked gates; do not publish without authorization.

title: GNCore Spreadsheets and Excel
description: Build, audit, clean, analyze, visualize, forecast, and automate spreadsheets with correct formulas and readable models.

workflows.title: Spreadsheet Model Design
workflows.description: Structure a spreadsheet model with clear inputs, calculations, outputs, and traceable assumptions.
workflows.procedure: Separate inputs and formulas, document units and sources, use consistent time axes, avoid hard-coded values inside formulas, and test base/downside cases. Protect source data from accidental edits.

workflows.title: Spreadsheet Formula Audit
workflows.description: Audit workbook formulas for broken references, inconsistencies, hard-codes, and calculation errors.
workflows.procedure: Inspect workbook sheets, named ranges, formula patterns, error cells, hidden regions, and external links. Trace key outputs to source cells and calculate independent spot checks.

workflows.title: Spreadsheet Data Cleaning
workflows.description: Clean tabular spreadsheet data with explicit rules and before/after reconciliation.
workflows.procedure: Preserve the raw sheet, inspect headers, types, blanks, duplicates, units, and merged cells, apply documented transformations, and compare row counts and summary totals after cleaning.

workflows.title: Spreadsheet Data Analysis
workflows.description: Answer an analytical question from workbook data with transparent formulas and checks.
workflows.procedure: Inspect grain, fields, data types, missing values, and workbook formulas before analysis. Use explicit filters and denominators, reconcile a sample to source rows, and state limitations.

workflows.title: Spreadsheet Dashboard
workflows.description: Build a decision-focused spreadsheet dashboard with stable formulas, labels, filters, and accessible visuals.
workflows.procedure: Define audience and decisions, use a clean data table, validate KPI formulas, label periods and units, add clear filter state, and test refresh and empty-data behavior.

workflows.title: Pivot Table Analysis
workflows.description: Create or review pivot analyses with verified source range, grouping, aggregation, and filter behavior.
workflows.procedure: Confirm each field's meaning and aggregation, expand the source range, check blanks and duplicates, and reconcile pivot totals to raw data. Document filters and refresh behavior.

workflows.title: Spreadsheet Forecast Model
workflows.description: Build or audit a forecast workbook with driver-based assumptions, scenarios, and error checks.
workflows.procedure: Separate actuals and forecasts, document drivers and units, extend formulas consistently, model scenarios explicitly, and test sensitivity and historical backtests. Do not present the forecast as certainty.

workflows.title: Spreadsheet Reconciliation
workflows.description: Reconcile two data sources with stable keys, exception categories, and totals control.
workflows.procedure: Normalize keys without changing source values, identify duplicates and unmatched rows, compare amounts with tolerances, categorize exceptions, and prove source and output totals reconcile.

workflows.title: Spreadsheet Automation
workflows.description: Automate repetitive workbook transformations with idempotent runs and safe output handling.
workflows.procedure: Inspect workbook structure and formulas, preserve input, define deterministic transformations, validate output schema and formulas, and test on a copy. Do not enable macros or execute unknown embedded code.

workflows.title: Spreadsheet Presentation Cleanup
workflows.description: Prepare a workbook for review or print with consistent formats, frozen headers, page setup, and clear labels.
workflows.procedure: Apply consistent number/date formats, remove accidental clutter without deleting source content, set print areas and repeat headers, test page breaks, and verify the saved workbook opens cleanly.

title: GNCore Supply Chain and Logistics
description: Plan demand, sourcing, suppliers, inventory, warehouses, transport, resilience, and supply-chain performance.

workflows.title: Demand Planning
workflows.description: Build a demand view with documented inputs, scenarios, and error checks.
workflows.procedure: Define item/location/time grain, reconcile history, flag promotions/stockouts, compare baselines, backtest horizons, show uncertainty and overrides.

workflows.title: Sourcing Strategy
workflows.description: Compare sourcing options for cost, quality, lead time, resilience, and compliance.
workflows.procedure: Use comparable landed costs, verify evidence, map dependencies and concentration risk, document tradeoffs, route restricted decisions to legal/procurement.

workflows.title: Supplier Performance Review
workflows.description: Review supplier performance with agreed measures and corrective actions.
workflows.procedure: Define denominators, reconcile systems, honor exclusions, include supplier context, and track accountable owners/dates.

workflows.title: Inventory Optimization
workflows.description: Identify inventory imbalances without hiding service risk.
workflows.procedure: Use current lead times and demand distributions, distinguish stock types, model carrying/shortage costs, validate service assumptions.

workflows.title: Warehouse Operations
workflows.description: Improve warehouse flow, safety, accuracy, and workload visibility.
workflows.procedure: Map handoffs, protect worker safety/accessibility, measure baseline, test with operators, monitor quality and fatigue.

workflows.title: Transportation Planning
workflows.description: Plan shipments with constraints, service, cost, and exception handling visible.
workflows.procedure: Validate dimensions, capacity, cutoffs, service and regulatory limits, compare total cost, and avoid invented carrier commitments.

workflows.title: Supply Chain Risk Review
workflows.description: Assess disruption exposure, early signals, and mitigation options.
workflows.procedure: Map critical tiers and single points, date evidence, separate likelihood/impact, test scenarios, set triggers, disclose visibility limits.

workflows.title: Supply Chain Exception Review
workflows.description: Triage exceptions by impact, owner, and next update.
workflows.procedure: Deduplicate alerts, validate identifiers/timestamps, prioritize by supplied rules, assign next action, escalate safety/compliance issues.

workflows.title: Purchase Order Reconciliation
workflows.description: Reconcile orders, receipts, invoices, and supplier records with traceable exceptions.
workflows.procedure: Match stable identifiers/tolerances, handle partial receipts and units, preserve originals, reconcile totals, route mismatches to approvers.

workflows.title: Supply Chain Sustainability Review
workflows.description: Review sustainability claims with boundaries, evidence, and data-quality limits.
workflows.procedure: Define scope and functional unit, trace primary/estimated data, check allocation and double counting, disclose uncertainty, avoid unsupported claims.

title: GNCore Testing
description: Design and run unit, integration, end-to-end, automation, and performance tests for important software behavior.

workflows.title: Unit Testing
workflows.description: Write fast, deterministic unit tests around public behavior and edge cases.
workflows.procedure: Identify the contract and boundaries of one unit. Test normal, boundary, invalid, and regression cases with clear arrange/act/assert structure. Mock only external boundaries, not the behavior under test. Keep tests deterministic and assert meaningful outputs or side effects; never loosen assertions to silence a failure.

workflows.title: Integration Testing
